chapters.title: Chapter 751: Changes
paragraphs: Lord Leviathan’s words hung in the air, thick with tension, as he stared daggers at King Zephyr. The words he had just spoken were not ones to be taken lightly.
The Innate Talent awakening pill is one that a beast, in particular, would not take for granted.
Every beast, whether aquatic, terrestrial, or Aerial, has one thing in common: they all chase after. That thing is innate talent.
Every True Beast strives to awaken at least one innate talent.
The beasts Kent killed in the Flame Region are beasts, all right, but they do not possess the innate intelligence that allows them to adapt, take on human form, and live within society.
They are basically monsters. However, with innate awareness, even a monster can become sociable.

Yet, it extends beyond innate awareness and intelligence. In fact, when the word, innate is mentioned, even gods would have to listen, for it is one thing that anyone, especially beasts, will benefit from.
Innate Talent comes in different forms.
There are innate talents, including Body, Mind, Spirit, Soul, Abilities, Aspects, and many more. Most even say that innate talent is what governs one’s ability to attain perfection.
It comes in different forms. Of course, there are differences when compared to Bloodline talent.
To someone like Kent, who is a dragon, awakening things like Dragon Aura, Dragon Claw, Dragon Breath, and the like are his bloodline talents.
In the case of a swordsman, Sword Aura, Sword Intent, Sword Body, and the like are his sword talents. However, when it comes to innate talents, they are the qualities that make a person unique.
Awakening an Innate Body is akin to sharpening your already-sharpened sword body. Innate Soul would enhance the soul of anyone who awakens it.
Most people believe that two individuals with the same bloodline can possess the same Innate talents. However, that is just not possible. Innate talents are unique to everyone.
Skills awakened from innate talents are unique and otherworldly.
Even if one is dumb, just awakening their Innate Mind will turn them into a once-in-a-lifetime genius.
It is what defines a cultivator, for it is through innate talent that one can comprehend their domains and later form the laws and build their world of law.

Lord Leviathan has already reached his limit. He had long refined his core, broken two limits, attained Sage Body cultivation, reached Tier 14 in soul cultivation, and reformed his foundation ten times.

The current him qualifies to compete with Spirit Emperors and Spirit Sovereigns. In fact, in the Celestial Conclave planetary alliance, he can be counted among the top ten strongest out of 64 worlds in the coalition.
That is how strong he is.
Essentially, he is an apex predator standing at the peak of this world.
But he knew this was not his limit. He knew with the right opportunity, he could rise even more, reaching great heights.
This was why he searched, spent years looking for ways to grow, and while he met failure many times, he managed to find an answer.
Awakening an Innate talent would allow him to raise his strength to a whole new level.

Of course, someone like him is not even meant to be in a medium world. Someone with his talent should be roaming in the high worlds, growing stronger every single day. So why is he still in a medium world...
The answer is simple: as someone who came from a race of predators, rising to a High World would be a waste when his foundation is still not up to standard.
To him, rising to the peak in the Medium World will be a better choice than running to the High World. Of course, that isn’t the only reason.
He is also waiting for something he had been looking forward to for the past 997 years, something that the 38 planetary alliances in the Kred Star system want to witness and participate in.
Most want to experience that before ascending to a high position.
So, he wants to grow stronger so that he can qualify to participate in this enterprise. This means he must obtain one of these Innate Talent awakening pills.
That is the only way for him to have a chance if he wants to secure a slot to participate.
"Do you know who this mysterious alchemist is?" Lord Leviathan asked, but King Zephyr shook his head.

"They didn’t say who this alchemist is. Only that he is talented, perhaps a Pill King or a Pill Sage; however, they announced there will be an auction three weeks from today. I believe they will sell one there."
"That is not good enough. Send men to the surface world. Let them blend into this auction, and when a chance appears, they must grab this pill no matter the consequences."

The order was absolute. There was no denying his words, for he meant everything he said. King Zephyr nodded, not daring to say anything. To him, he would bow to Lord Leviathan first before bowing to a god.
"What about Kent Madson?" Queen Nyssa, the leader of the Giant Octopus race, asked.

Of course, at the moment, she is in her human form, but in combat, a giant purple octopus with razor-sharp tentacles would appear, and that is why she is the second strongest of the seven sea leaders.

"Leave him to our geniuses in the Primal Beast Sect. I am sure soon the interplanetary competition will start, and knowing the Supreme Immortal Sect, they would want their core disciples to represent this world.
This means they will participate in the Selection competition. If this Kent is as good as you all paint him to be, then I am sure they will add him to their team.

He will make a good kill for our geniuses. We don’t have to waste time on him. The priority now is the pill or the recipe. I dont care what method you will be using. As long as I get what I want in the end, I don’t care."

Lord Leviathan stayed for a few seconds before vanishing from the dome. The seven leaders remained there for a few more minutes, planning what to do next. After everything was said and done, they also left.
They knew how vital this pill was to their leader, so they would under no circumstances fail to acquire and deliver it.
They couldn’t afford to fail, so they were each preparing for a major undertaking that would bring about significant changes in the world.
The sea race that had remained hidden for years now would soon be making its appearance to the entire world.
Of course, while this was a big deal to the rest of the world, their intentions for making themselves known weren’t noble at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 752: Progress After Five Days [Bonus]
paragraphs: [Flame Valley - Core Region. Day 5/11]
"Cyran, you and Madea should flank through the right. Arion, Norion, and Dorren, you three shouldn’t get too close if you dont want to turn into a barbecue meat paste.
Princess Elowen, you are the one who would be going for the kill, so time it well, and finally, Helyra and Elia, just keep it distracted by bombarding it with nonstop attacks."
Kent issues a series of orders while hovering 800 meters away from a scorched battlefield.
Locked in a fierce battle are the eight Half-Elves and a crab-like beast, large enough to fill a 500-meter radius.
It had already been five days since Kent and the Half-Elves entered the Flame Valley, and for the past five days, it had been nonstop battles.
They had already cleared five of the twelve locations mapped by the tower, and so far, they were handling the last beast at the sixth location.

Cyran and Madea were flanking the beast, aiming one arrow after another at all the exposed parts of its stone-like carapace. Its body was large, with twelve thick legs of which two were large enough to crash through anything it struck.

It had eyes lining its head, allowing it to see in all directions. So despite the two archers doing everything they could to overwhelm it, no matter how deadly the shots are taken, the crab always defends and counters.

However, the fact that they weren’t making much progress didn’t mean they weren’t making headway. If anything, Kent had already made sure they understood the battle dynamics in the first few minutes, so thirty minutes into the battle, they had already managed to pick up some patterns.

The beast, in essence, was unkillable, at least not by a bunch of weaklings who were not even one-thousandth of its size. However, they weren’t the same Half-Elves who cowered under the pressure of the Drake five days ago.
They had fought crazy battles, and thanks to Kent’s guidelines, they had adapted and strengthened their resolve, which helped them start to improve steadily.
They had already become much stronger, and with every last one of them possessing Tier 6 soul flames, with Elowen even at Tier 7, the battle wasn’t too far out of their grasp.
If anything, the longer they fought, the more they adapted.
Norion circled one large leg of the crab, which tried to land its colossal leg on him. However, Norion was faster and moved, but not before cutting a wound into the leg.
Madea, who was tracking Norion as if he were her target, shot an arrow at the wounded leg, and with precision, the arrow went through and dissolved.
This made Madea smile.
"It won’t be long now," she thought as more arrows left her bow. Cyran had already launched an attack on one of the crab’s eyes and was looking to take out more.
Naturally, he wasn’t shooting at just any random eye. If anything, he was aiming strategically at a specific point in the eye.
So far, if he managed to take out two eyes, the crab would lose peripheral vision, creating a blind spot at a narrow point on its left.
This would allow Princess Elowen to deal a fatal attack, one that would cause more damage than the one dealt by Madea.
Helyra waved her staff, conjuring a rather large fireball.
It towered over the crab, and then she dropped it.
At the same time, Elia, the second mage, also conjured a large spear made out of her soul flame and shot it at the crab.
Helyra’s fireball didn’t manage to land because the crab defended using its own fireball, but the spear landed and created a dent on its stony carapace.
It was just a dent, but that was enough to create an opening for Princess Elowen to fire her second arrow since the start of the battle.

It shattered the shell on the crab’s back, and the cold flame arrow entered its body. Another followed, and three more streaked through the air, landing heavily on these shells and creating a rather thunderous explosion.
"Yes."
Princess Elowen celebrated despite the giant crab still moving about, unleashing hellfire on everyone.
"This sucker just won’t die," Cyran said as he took out a second eye, giving Dorren an opening to get close and slash his sword at one more leg, cutting a wound into it like Norion did.
Madea, of course, was quick to send another poison arrow into the new wound, causing her to smile.
"I need two more legs, and we will be able to kill this sucker," Madea made sure the three teammates wielding the sword knew what had to be done. Norion, Doreen, and Arion nodded and got to work.
Norion darted around another massive leg.
The crab slammed it down hard, sending dust flying.
Norion barely dodged, feeling the heat of the ground crack beneath him. He slashed quickly, cutting into the thick armor again.
The beast roared, swinging its leg wildly. However, Cyran was a step ahead with another arrow, taking out its third eye.
The moment the third arrow was released, Princess Elowen fired another arrow, this time at one of the eyes. It was a powerful strike that pushed the crab back.
However, before it could stabilize on its leg, another arrow pierced the second blinded eye. It staggered and swayed to one side, as if it had become drunk.
Not that it was privileged to have a drink or two.
The drunkenness was due to the poisoned arrows Madea fired. They were lethal enough to leave the crab swaying like a drunkard.
Naturally, Princess Elowen knew it was time to kill the sucker, so she fired one arrow after another, targeting only the eyes.
In no time, one part of the creature’s body began to freeze. The flame Princess Elowen wielded was much more lethal and freezing cold.
It was a soul flame, alright, but her flame burned with icy coldness. Sending one arrow after another into the crab’s body was more than enough to freeze it slowly.
It took several dozen arrows, but gradually, the crab succumbed to the onslaught and stopped moving, frozen solid like a forest shaped like a crab.
"Amazing," Kent said as he flew and landed on the back of the crab to collect the flame spirit and store the body.
"That was the last of the flame beasts in this region. We now have only six more areas to explore within the next six days, as we must return to Elarion for the Flame Tower opening.
But for now, you’ve all worked hard, so you must be rewarded." Kent produced sixteen flame spirits, bringing smiles to their exhausted faces.

chapters.title: Chapter 753: Uncle Drake Has Evolved [Bonus]
paragraphs: After the dangerous battle against the Crab Flame Beast, the team rested for only two hours before moving to the next region to handle the flame beasts there.
Of course, before leaving, Kent shared the flame spirits among the seven of them, keeping only two for himself.
It was no guarantee that absorbing the two flames would finally give him the boost to reach the 8th Tier in flame quality.
However, he managed to acquire more powerful flame aspects, making his soul flame even stronger to the point that reaching Tier 8 wasn’t his concern.
What Kent was after was to master a flame art and see what his soul flame would be capable of.
Of course, he had already expected that the moment he obtained a flame art, his combat power would skyrocket.
But he didn’t know just how much progress he would make. So, Kent decided that for now, he would wait to see the changes manifest themselves, and when that happened, he would know what to do next.

Next, Kent had officially made the Half-Elves, except Princess Elowen, his subordinates by adding them to the Guardian Hand. The moment he did, he felt like his domain of influence had spread yet again.

Aside from that, he also felt their loyalty levels, and while he never expected it, all seven were already above 80%. That was more than enough to show they were adapting to his teaching, and soon, they would fully adapt to him.
Once that happened, Kent knew they would become much more integrated into his plans for them.
After adding them, they progressed forward, aiming to finish the battles much faster and spend some time absorbing the cores they’d collected.
The battles in the 7th, 8th, and 9th regions were not that harrowing.
But they weren’t easy either.

Thankfully, it ended much faster than he had hoped. But right when the 9th battle ended, something started to happen inside the Tower, causing Kent to pause and send everyone into the tower for the first time.

They appeared inside the Legion Tower, causing them all to widen their eyes at the change in scenery. However, they couldn’t take in the sight to their heart’s content, as the moment they appeared, a powerful aura explosion emanated from one side of the vast space.
They turned to the direction the aura came from, only to see a colossal dragon landing in the air, looking at them.
Uncle Drake had evolved from being a Flame Drake to a True Flame Dragon.
His Dragon body has taken on a red hue with a few dark patches here and there. Of course, being a flame dragon, the red was much more dominant on his colossal body.
The scales shimmered with an otherworldly glow, one that made him appear both majestic and warrior-like.

He had a rather large set of wings spread wide, casting a large shadow on the ground. The claws on his four legs looked terrifyingly sharp. They ended in dark, metallic claws, one that looked almost as if it could claw through reality itself.
And looking at his massive body and lazily scaled tail, it wouldn’t take a genius to know a dragon of this caliber had already reached the peak and needed a bigger field to play in.
Kent scanned him while paying attention to the crazy red eyes and the two sets of twisted dark dragon horns mounted on his head.
⟦Name: Uncle Drake⟧
⟦Bloodline: Flame Kings Lineage (20%)⟧
⟦Race: Primordial Flame Dragon⟧
⟦Realm: Core Formation (7/7)⟧
⟦Soul Cultivation: Tier 13⟧
⟦Body Cultivation: Diamond⟧
⟦Flame Resistance: Super⟧
⟦Flame Comprehension: High⟧
’Well, that is a nice display for someone who had just become a dragon,’ Kent smiled, watching the large dragon stare back at him.
"Congratulations on becoming a dragon... Looks like your years of dreaming have finally become a reality. Although I must say, you are much more impressive than I expected."
Uncle Drake didn’t immediately speak. Instead, he transformed into his human form, now assuming a much more refined and handsome appearance.
He maintained his red hair, but now he had a rather cute dark horn framing his handsome face perfectly. Although he still appeared to be in his late 40s.

His height had decreased, now standing at 7 feet, but with a well-toned, muscular look. Even the three sets of red dragon scales on his forehead made him look even more eye-catching than he had in his demi-drake form.
His wings could be summoned and put away at will, so unless he needed them, he didn’t have to have them on his back.
He moved and stopped a few meters away from Kent, then smiled. "It was all thanks to you. I would have never made this progress anytime soon."
"Then I guess it was indeed destined for us to meet. So, congratulations to you for becoming a powerful version of who you wanted to be.
Now, I can boldly say the moment you appear in the outside world, everyone will feel what it feels like to be called a powerhouse."
Kent took a few items and handed them to Uncle Drake. "Use the time here to strengthen your foundation... We still have some work to do on the outside.
Once we get back to the Half-Elves’ land, I will introduce you to their king and queen as the kingdom protector. After that, we will see what happens next."
Uncle Drake nodded. He had already planned to become useful, having finally achieved his dreams. Next, if he continued to strengthen himself, he would be allowed to spread his wings.
For now, using his intimidating presence to deter those who meant harm to the Half-Elves wasn’t something to be angry about.
Kent turned to the Half-Elves and could tell they wanted to stay in the tower for a bit. However, he knew they had a mission to handle.
"We are leaving. When we come out of the Flame Tower, I will allow you to explore this domain. For now, we have work to do."
Though they didn’t want to leave, they had to nod reluctantly, and with a wave of his hand, they were sent back to the outside world.
"We only have three more regions to clear, and we will be done. The rest of the days will be spent on something else, so let’s get back to work."
And so they did. They went back to hunting flame beasts for the next few days. On the 8th day, they cleared all 12 regions and started to absorb the cores.
Meanwhile, geniuses from every race were already preparing to enter the Flame Tower, located in the Beasts Empire...

After adding them, they progressed forward, aiming to finish the battles much faster and spend some time absorbing the cores they’d collected.
The battles in the 7th, 8th, and 9th regions were not that harrowing.
But they weren’t easy either.
Thankfully, it ended much faster than he had hoped.
But right when the 9th battle ended, something started to happen inside the Tower, causing Kent to pause and send everyone into the tower for the first time.
They appeared inside the Legion Tower, causing them all to widen their eyes at the change in scenery.
However, they couldn’t take in the sight to their heart’s content, as the moment they appeared, a powerful aura explosion emanated from one side of the vast space.
They turned to the direction the aura came from, only to see a colossal dragon landing in the air, looking at them.
Uncle Drake had evolved from being a Flame Drake to a True Flame Dragon.
His Dragon body has taken on a red hue with a few dark patches here and there.
Of course, being a flame dragon, the red was much more dominant on his colossal body.
The scales shimmered with an otherworldly glow, one that made him appear both majestic and warrior-like.
He had a rather large set of wings spread wide, casting a large shadow on the ground.
The claws on his four legs looked terrifyingly sharp.
They ended in dark, metallic claws, one that looked almost as if it could claw through reality itself.
And looking at his massive body and lazily scaled tail, it wouldn’t take a genius to know a dragon of this caliber had already reached the peak and needed a bigger field to play in.
Kent scanned him while paying attention to the crazy red eyes and the two sets of twisted dark dragon horns mounted on his head.
⟦Name: Uncle Drake⟧
⟦Bloodline: Flame Kings Lineage (20%)⟧
⟦Race: Primordial Flame Dragon⟧
⟦Realm: Core Formation (7/7)⟧
⟦Soul Cultivation: Tier 13⟧
⟦Body Cultivation: Diamond⟧
⟦Flame Resistance: Super⟧
⟦Flame Comprehension: High⟧
’Well, that is a nice display for someone who had just become a dragon,’ Kent smiled, watching the large dragon stare back at him.
"Congratulations on becoming a dragon...
Looks like your years of dreaming have finally become a reality.
Although I must say, you are much more impressive than I expected."
Uncle Drake didn’t immediately speak.
Instead, he transformed into his human form, now assuming a much more refined and handsome appearance.
He maintained his red hair, but now he had a rather cute dark horn framing his handsome face perfectly.
Although he still appeared to be in his late 40s.
His height had decreased, now standing at 7 feet, but with a well-toned, muscular look.
Even the three sets of red dragon scales on his forehead made him look even more eye-catching than he had in his demi-drake form.
His wings could be summoned and put away at will, so unless he needed them, he didn’t have to have them on his back.
He moved and stopped a few meters away from Kent, then smiled.
"It was all thanks to you.
I would have never made this progress anytime soon."
"Then I guess it was indeed destined for us to meet.
So, congratulations to you for becoming a powerful version of who you wanted to be.
Now, I can boldly say the moment you appear in the outside world, everyone will feel what it feels like to be called a powerhouse."
Kent took a few items and handed them to Uncle Drake.
"Use the time here to strengthen your foundation...
We still have some work to do on the outside.
Once we get back to the Half-Elves’ land, I will introduce you to their king and queen as the kingdom protector.
After that, we will see what happens next."
Uncle Drake nodded.
He had already planned to become useful, having finally achieved his dreams.
Next, if he continued to strengthen himself, he would be allowed to spread his wings.
For now, using his intimidating presence to deter those who meant harm to the Half-Elves wasn’t something to be angry about.
Kent turned to the Half-Elves and could tell they wanted to stay in the tower for a bit.
However, he knew they had a mission to handle.
"We are leaving.
When we come out of the Flame Tower, I will allow you to explore this domain.
For now, we have work to do."
Though they didn’t want to leave, they had to nod reluctantly, and with a wave of his hand, they were sent back to the outside world.
"We only have three more regions to clear, and we will be done.
The rest of the days will be spent on something else, so let’s get back to work."
And so they did.
They went back to hunting flame beasts for the next few days.
On the 8th day, they cleared all 12 regions and started to absorb the cores.
Meanwhile, geniuses from every race were already preparing to enter the Flame Tower, located in the Beasts Empire...

chapters.title: Chapter 754: Back to Elarion
paragraphs: [Flame Valley – Core Region. Day 11]
⟦Your Weak Flame Resistance Grows Stronger⟧
Kent read the message with a calm expression.
It had already been 11 days since they entered the Flame Valley. The past three days were spent absorbing the boatload of cores they’d harvested.
He shared it among them all, making sure everyone received an equal share of the loot.

Kent knew absorbing the cores wouldn’t do much for the growth of his flame resistance. However, he was mistaken. Although the resistance was still in its weak stage, Kent felt growth in more than one area.
First, of course, was his flame resistance. It had become much more powerful now. Though he still remained at the weak stage, Kent knew his resistance to flame attacks was in no way weak.

If anything, he was now more powerful than before. Of course, he suspected something at first, but he wasn’t sure. Now, he was able to pinpoint why he needed so much to build his resistance compared to the Half-Elves.
At first, when he gained the flame resistance while crossing the valley, he sensed that despite gaining flame resistance, it felt as though the scorching, heated environment no longer affected him.

If anything, it was more like, despite attaining his flame resistance, he should at least feel the heat on his skin like it should have been. But he didn’t, and that was due to his ’Eternal Draconic Jade Body.’

Kent first had the Primordial Chaos Dragon Body when he came to this world, but when he was rewarded with the innate Eternal Jade Body, it mutated with his previous body, creating something new—something more dangerous.
This allowed him to remain in the heated environment despite attaining only weak flame resistance, without any discomfort for as long as he wanted.
This also meant his Eternal Draconic Jade Body had grown even stronger. Even Kent could see there was more to this new body than he had initially thought.
But even so, he could tell things would soon get much more interesting.
If weak flame resistance was also already this powerful, then he most certainly was looking forward to when he would be attaining High or Super Flame Resistance.
The third thing he sensed had grown stronger was his Body Cultivation. Having a diamond body is a prerequisite for joining most body cultivation sects in the high worlds.
However, Kent had already reached a stage, even without much progress, where a flame attack coming from someone, even with high or super comprehension of the flame, wouldn’t do much damage to him.

First, his own soul flame was strong enough to counter most attacks. Then there was his flame resistance, which, thanks to his Eternal Draconic Jade Body, had made him much stronger against any flame element.
Then, if that was not enough, he also had his diamond body, which Kent knew, unless the person was a monster like him, his diamond body would make it impossible to hurt him with flame attacks.
Of course, he had his ultimate defense, which was his dragon scale. But he didn’t think he would need that anytime soon.
If he were to layer all these robust defenses, then there was no doubt his defense had already reached a level even an average Spirit Lord would find it hard to hurt him.
However, that didn’t mean he would just let any attack land on his body, as if he were some maniac. Having a robust body wasn’t an invitation to let just any attack land on his body.
However, while Kent made some progress on many fronts, he wasn’t the only one walking away much stronger.
All eight Half-Elves he brought with him now had weak flame resistance. In fact, Princess Elowen, Madea, Norion, and Helyra even surprised Kent when they gained a weak Flame Comprehension.
This meant Norion and Madea were already guaranteed to enter the sect.

This is because one of the main reasons the sect uses the Flame Tower to select candidates is that, before one can make progress inside the tower, they must first comprehend the essence of the flame, which in turn allows them to learn a flame art.
So, having a firm grasp of the flame is a vital part of entering the tower, and now that Madea and Norion had comprehended that essence, their progress inside the tower would be swift.
However, while Dorren and Elia had yet to comprehend the essence of a flame, they were only a few steps away from attaining it.
Kent even suspected they would make their breakthrough within a few hours of entering the Flame Tower.
But Kent wasn’t even looking for that time to come. He already had a fix, and that fix was Uncle Drake.
As someone with a high understanding of the flame, passing his flame essence through their bodies was more than enough to help them.
That was what Uncle Drake was doing for them.
Kent himself was making headway on something even more vital... He purchased the only Flame Path art that the tower suddenly added to the Tower store.
It cost him 100 million tower points, but so far, despite making just 2% progress, his understanding of the flame had improved.

It was a technique with a name that even Kent didn’t know if it was exaggerated or not. But the ’Hellfire Damnation Flame Art’ allowed him to understand the flame to the point he would be able to create hell on earth.
The tower would register his progress when his understanding reached 5%, so for now, he wasn’t in a rush. Comprehending a flame art skill was something he could do quite easily.
After a while, Uncle Drake managed to help Elia and Dorren attain weak comprehension.
"This is wonderful. If I had known I could use the flame this way, I wouldn’t have struggled in the battles we fought," Dorren said with a smile, examining his green flame.
The rest shared his thoughts.
"Don’t look down, you two. The moment we get back, Uncle Drake will help you gain some understanding, too."
Arion and Cyran nodded. Soon, they headed out of the core region. On the way, all flame beasts they came across either ran or were killed before they could attack.
With the primal aura coming from Uncle Drake, no beast, regardless of how aware they were, would think about attacking him. That would be suicide.
Thanks to him, they appeared outside the valley within 30 minutes and began riding back to Elarion.
The journey was much smoother.

Everyone had gained something, and to Arion, Cyran, and Helyra, they’d made so much that after selling everything at the adventurers’ guild, if they chose not to work for thousands of years, they wouldn’t run out of money.
All the beasts they killed in the Inner and Core regions were given to them.
In less than three hours, they were back in Elarion.

chapters.title: Chapter 755: Introducing Uncle Drake
paragraphs: "What happened to you eight... Just a few days ago, you all appeared like greenhouse flowers, but now, I can’t even begin to fathom how this was even possible." Queen Jascia shook her head, looking at the eight half-elves who had taken Flame Valley.
They smile, feeling proud of their minimal achievements. Kent has already made them aware he has big plans for them, so they knew soon, their Queen would have yet another thing to be shocked about.
She turned to Kent and said, "Thank you."
Kent nodded with a smile, standing beside Uncle Drake.
She didn’t need an explanation to know that the half-elves standing before her were no longer simple. She felt the aura coming from them, and as a warrior, she recognized their strength.
King Thalirion and the Ten Elders were also present since Kent and his team first came to the palace before heading to their various homes.
They also recognise the improvement based on the aura oozing from the Half-Elves. They knew things had finally turned for the better for them.

"They’ve all worked hard, and the reward is as you all can see. Of course, with me around, soon enough, the whole world will understand the advantage of having two sets of blood flowing through your bodies."
The King and the elders couldn’t deny his words. They knew Kent was more than capable of doing that. They now more than ever trusted him to the point that they would do anything he asked them.
Hearing his promise wasn’t one they would doubt. And Kent isn’t a greedy person. So far, the Half-elves are blessing him with millions of soul essence every single day.

This means that while going all out to help him isn’t required, he understood the value in quality, so he would do all he could, and regardless of how much it cost him, he would transform these half-elves into a powerful race.
The stronger they become, the more powerful he also becomes, so being greedy will be depriving himself of an opportunity to build a universe inside his soul.
"By the way, this is Uncle Drake. He is a Flame Dragon, and while there are flame dragons in this world, they cannot be compared to him.
We met at the Valley, and one thing led to another; he will be staying here for at least the next three years. I believe with him here, you wouldn’t have to worry about anything."
The elders were visibly shaken when they heard what Kent said.
They’d been wondering who the terrifying dragon behind Kent was, but now, hearing he was on their side and would be their guardian for the next few years, they couldn’t help but shake a bit.
"We greet Senior Drake. Please take care of us for the next few years you will be staying here," the elders said, bowing slightly.
While they could tell Kent was indeed young, though terrifying, they were also able to determine that Uncle Drake was old and powerful.
So they paid their respect, and Uncle Drake nodded.

"No need to be polite. I will merely be staying here as a means to deter all those with evil intent. As to whether I will even get a chance to do that, considering none of you is any weaker than I am, I guess we will soon find out."
The elders smiled, reading the subtle compliment hidden within Uncle Drake’s words. He acknowledged them and made sure they knew he wasn’t there to steal their thunder.
But of course, when they couldn’t handle it, he would step in. Because while nobody would want to admit it, even Kent himself knew the dragon standing beside him was a terror.
Even Kent doesn’t think he can defeat him.

The drake he met a week and a few days ago was no more. This time, something primal, something straight from the Primordial Era, had awakened, and while Kent could sense it, he knew something was still hidden from him.

He didn’t know if the universe was trying to protect his feelings, but something about Uncle Drake still made his skin crawl. That alone made him wonder just what could make him, a chaos dragon, feel that way.
"You all can retire back to your homes. Tomorrow morning, all eight of you should assemble here. Of course, be prepared for anything," Queen Jascia said, and everyone scattered.
"Uncle Drake, your lodging will be in the palace and has already been prepared. You can head there when you are done."

Uncle Drake nodded and turned to Kent. "If you want a place to get a stronger flame spirit, try entering the Hell Zone in the Ancient Battlefield of Parting. Of course, be prepared for the dangers that await you.
You will die before you know how it happened." After those words, he turned and started following the maids, who, judging by the look on their faces, were already charmed by the dragon man.

After he left, King Thalirion looked at Kent. "Where did you get such a monster from? Not even the Crystal Dragon King has this much presence. In fact, comparing him to this senior is a huge insult to senior Drake."

"Honestly, I don’t know how dangerous he is, but fear not, he is a trusted companion." Everyone accepted that answer and later dispersed. Kent followed the king and the queen back to the meeting hall since they had something else to report to him.

It turned out they would now be meeting with the elves after the Flame Tower opening. Knowing the half-elves are rising, they want to make peace. However, whether their intentions are noble or not, they will soon find out.

Tomorrow, the tower will open, and they will head to Kiryu, the kingdom of the Qilin race, who are the leaders of the beast races. The tower is located there, and that is where all other races will send their best and brightest.
[Universe Core. Home of Lady Universe]

The beautiful lady sat in her chair with a smile on her face. She had just watched Kent and Uncle Drake stand side by side, and while it wouldn’t be amusing to someone like the half-elves who saw it, she had a different experience.
She had already seen all of Kent’s past lives, and that was the main reason she was smiling. Of course, it didn’t take long for the Enchantress’ voice to enter her ears.
"So they started as companions this time, huh... I wonder what will happen when they get back their memories of how they met during the primordial era."
Lady Universe laughed, "They will probably try to kill each other, knowing them."
"I most certainly would love to see the Flame King and the Chaos Dragon exchange blows and claws one of these days."
The Enchantress chuckled, "It will be a good one, considering our dear Chaos would most certainly want to fight the Flame King again."

"Well, Chaos already seems to notice there is something icky about the Flame King. He doesn’t know it was his memories, but of course, I may be the Universe’s heart, but I don’t control the flow of the Universe’s fate, so we can only wait."
"We should probably prepare for that battle, for I can already feel it brewing in the air."
The two ladies were almost happy to see a battle that once shook the primordial Era. The Chaos dragon and the Flame King met as enemies but fell as brothers.
Now, they are back again, and as to whether the rivalry will continue, only time will tell...

chapters.title: Chapter 756: Day of The Flame Tower Awakening [Bonus]
paragraphs: Dorren, Madea, Elia, Norion, Cyran, Arion, and Helyra came early the next day, as the queen had instructed them the day before.
She asked for all of them to come, and so they did. They were seated inside the hall where all meetings were held.
Kent hadn’t arrived yet, for he had gone into the tower to handle a few things. But the elders were present.

Of course, Princess Elowen and her parents entered the hall a few minutes after the seven half-elves arrived. A few minutes after the arrival of the royals, Kent also entered the hall with Uncle Drake.
"Everyone is here," King Thalirion said, looking at the lineup that would be heading to the land of the Qilin race.
Of course, only three elders would go with them, considering Uncle Drake would also be heading there with them. The other seven elders would ensure the kingdom remained intact while they were away.
The tower would remain open for only three days.
"Since we are all here, we should be on our way." The king took out a cylindrical-shaped artifact and channeled his energy into it.
The moment he did, a portal opened for them to enter.

"Remember, if you can’t handle the flame tower, don’t force yourself. You are all less than 100 years old, so you can try again in the next three years when it opens," King Thalirion said, and everyone nodded.
"Very well. In that case, we can enter now. This portal will transport us directly to the Flame Mountains, where the tower is located. Expect the judgmental and hostile stares of the other races.

However, don’t mind them. We are there to show them what we are made of, so we should focus on that instead." The king turned to Kent and smiled, "You can do whatever you want, knowing your imaginary history with them."
Kent smiled and then stepped aside to let everyone enter. They did, and soon, he also entered with Uncle Drake.
[Flame Mountains. Five minutes before the Half-Elves appeared]
The Flame Mountain was as its name described. It was a mountain sitting inside a lava pool.
Of course, calling it a pool was an understatement.

It was more like a sea of lava, with the mountain standing at its center, towering several kilometers high. It was the location of the infamous tower, said to have been left behind by an immortal hundreds of thousands of years ago.
The history books described him as a very powerful flame cultivator, someone whose understanding of flame was on a different level.
He had created hundreds of flame arts.
According to observations, every three years, when the tower opens, these flame arts will be made available to all those worthy to have them.
They would be presented with different flame arts, and depending on one’s comprehension of flame, they would be required to learn the flame art to some extent.
This extent was, of course, the third form. The reason for this was that those who mastered fewer than three forms of a flame art wouldn’t be able to progress after they left the tower.
However, those who mastered at least three forms would get the rest of the skills imprinted in their mind.
This meant that long after they left the Flame Tower, they would be able to master the remaining forms, which typically numbered up to the 7th form.
Of course, there was no limit to how many one could master, but in most cases, due to the limited time given, most only managed to comprehend one skill/flame art.

Some, however, managed to walk away with two, and the record, which hadn’t yet been broken, was held by the Pill Princess, who comprehended four flame Arts, with the second-best only comprehending two.
So while the Supreme Immortal Sect only required one to master one skill to the third form, one was not limited to only one skill.
The Flame Demons were the first to arrive, with 15 representatives that would be entering the Tower, three elders, and the Flame Demon King.
The Ice Demons came second, with the same number, and when all seven demon states, including the Dark Elves, arrived, each had the same number of representatives.
On one side of the space stood the Shadow Demons.
Shax, the demon that Velyra beat the shit out and later became Kent allies who he had been getting his information from stood beside the Shadow Demon King, looking as impossible as he could.
Of course, having purple skin didn’t exactly scream subtle when they were demons clad in dark robes. However, they are unique in their way.
A while later, the dwarves also appeared, numbering 26 short people. Twenty will enter the flame tower, and the remaining six are the elderly and the dwarf King.
Though they were expected to be short, to a pitifully low height, a few managed to reach five feet, and not all of them were muscular.
They were quite adorable, and watching them walk through their portal showed that, though short, they were not weak.

The Elves appeared after the dwarves and stood on their own spot, looking as prideful as ever. Of course, the moment they appeared, the hostility between them and the Dark Elves started to add more heat to the fire.
The Beastkins also came. The Beast Empire comprised the Foxkin, Tigerkin, Wolfkin, Boarkin, Hawkkin, Serpentkin, Stagkin, Bearkin, Lynxkin, and finally, the Qilin.
After them, the dragons appeared, with the Earth Dragons emerging first, followed by the Flame Dragons, and finally, the strongest of the dragons, the Crystal Dragons.
The only ones left to appear were the Half-Elves, who, after the dragons appeared, took two minutes to arrive.
Naturally, they were the main race everyone was waiting for, considering every last race there came with not one, but at least three of their elders and either their queen or king.
They knew the Half-Elves were a hot commodity now and easy to intimidate, so they came with their presence and started to wait for them.
Of course, they were waiting for someone else to come out.
When the portal opened and the first half-elf walked through it, all eyes landed on him.
Dorren was overwhelmed, feeling a chill run down his spine, but before he could freeze to death, King Thalirion appeared and placed his hand on his shoulder.
Arion, Cyran, Madea, Elia, Helyra, and Norion walked out after the king. After them, Lord Yael, Lord Orrin, and Lord Mylior also walked out.
Queen Jascia and Princess Elowen came next, and then there was a short pause before Kent and Uncle Drake walked through the portal.
Some eyes widened, a few frowned, while some smiled...

chapters.title: Chapter 757: Hostilities and Calm [Bonus]
paragraphs: The first person Kent saw was the Elven Queen.
Of course, he saw her beauty, which was undeniable. Elves are naturally beautiful, so he expected nothing less from their Queen.
However, while he saw something beautiful, the queen saw the cause of all her troubles.
First, four of her best younger generation lost their limbs in the most traumatizing way. Of course, they were scared forever, for their defeat was one they would never forget.
The last time any of them came out was when she sent them to Elarion in hopes of sabotaging the competition. But that didn’t happen, and now they can’t even show their faces.
Then came what he did to her soldiers. After their return from Elarion, they were never the same.
The discovery of some of the worst betrayals that shouldn’t have occurred between men who called themselves brothers was something that had caused a fracture that can’t be rectified.
However, if that wasn’t enough, he also went ahead and threatened their ancestor, Lady Aelith, who has since entered seclusion and hasn’t emerged yet.

It was some of the worst days of her life. And now, out of nowhere, the half-Elves are rising, and the worst part is that there was nothing she could do about it for her mother, as she had already warned her that doing something as foolish as attacking the half-Elves would be the end of them all.
All this added to the fact that she had asked for a meeting, and the half-Elves had the audacity to tell her they could meet her in five days and that she should come herself.
In the past, the half-Elves would have gone to them, but the tables have now turned on them. Now, they are the ones on the bad side of the coin.
Of course, there was Queen Jascia too, whom she knew deep in her heart that with her now back from the dead, things wouldn’t be the same anymore.
Two thousand three hundred ninety-eight years ago, she was a promising talent they were nurturing to lead the Elven army to greater heights.
They spent a lot of resources in the hope that when she reached the stage they wanted, she would be announced as their beacon of hope, for she was indeed worthy of being called so.
However, just when their investment was about to bear fruit, she grew wings instead and married into the race they’d been trying to suppress.
That alone was a giant slap to the Elves’ ego.
So seeing her alive wasn’t something they were happy about, and Queen Elenara made it plain from her frown.
Kent, just like Queen Jascia, was smiling as he gazed at the queen.
It was funny how hatred can make even the most beautiful look ugly. The Queen was at the moment ugly with hatred.
On the other side, in the direction of the Dragons, Uncle Drake was also looking at them with an expression that said he wasn’t even going to place them in his eyes.
To him, they are weak, and he showed it in his gaze.
Naturally, the arrogance was something the dragons noticed, and this pissed them off. King Veyron of the Flame Dragon race narrowed his eyes at Uncle Drake when he saw his smug expression.
He knew at first glance that the dragon walking among the Half-Elves wasn’t one of his. As the leader of his race, there was no way he wouldn’t recognize someone as impressive as Uncle Drake.
So this could only mean he wasn’t one of them. But then the question remains, "Where is he from?"
The answer remains a mystery. Of course, perhaps if they had asked, Uncle Drake would have told them, but their arrogance wouldn’t allow them to do that.
If anything, they are too prideful even to lower themselves and ask a question that would have perhaps been a waking moment for them.
But despite recognizing Uncle Drake’s presence, they would rather die than acknowledge him.
The demons were also looking at Kent with eyes that contained both animosity and weariness. They didn’t know whether to attack him or let him be.
But of course, for now, they wouldn’t dare cause any fight.
However, the same cannot be said for later. Knowing what they will gain giving him to the Hand, they already wanted to see him captured or even better, dead.
The Beasts and the Dwarves were the only ones looking at Kent and the Half-Elves with neutral expressions.
Unlike the other races, they don’t hold any animosity against the Half-Elves or Kent.
If anything, they want to know him more.
After the Half-Elves settled down, Kent looked at the Dragons and smiled.
’They are as strong as expected of dragons. But damn, the arrogance is just too much. Can’t they be like everyone else and behave like normal people?’ Kent said inwardly before looking at the demons.
From their hostile expressions, it was clear they wanted his head. However, Kent wouldn’t allow them the courtesy. Of course, he wasn’t looking forward to a bloodbath.
’The tower had activated the ’Guardian Hand’ and ’Guardian Allies.’ All I have to do is create a situation whereby they would ally with the Half-Elves."
’If I were to make all of them powerful, one of these days they will try to go to war to seize the resources of one another. Especially when I am not around
So there can be only one leader, and I chose the Half-Elves. One day, I can see a race connected to one powerful race that none of them could compete against, even if they were to combine forces.’
Of course, Kent has already planned everything to the last full stop.
He wasn’t trying to turn the Half-Elves into supreme monarchs. No, that is the last thing he wanted. However, he also wasn’t going to say he wouldn’t be biased.
He plans to make the Half-Elves his main stronghold so that, without even announcing their name, everyone will know they are powerful.

Then, using the second aspect of the Guardian Tower he had awakened, he would make the other races ally with the Half-Elves. This means that the moment this alliance is formed, his protection will also extend to them.
This also means that through an alliance alone, he will start earning soul essence from them.
But he wouldn’t be obligated to help them grow like he would for the Half-Elves. But then again, when he is done with the Half-Elves, their allies will gain the reward too.
In other words, instead of him going to their aid when they need help, the Half-Elves will do that for him, as they are allies.
He can’t stay in the Medium World forever, so he ought to ensure they have a way to survive on their own.
Of course, he can easily get back to a medium world even from an immortal world, but having an entire race take care of future issues is one he wouldn’t deny.
He might be in seclusion when something grim happens. Without a force to represent him, things will quickly go awry.
’It would probably be easy to deal with the Dwarves first. The rest will happen eventually. But for now, the Dwarves are the target.’
Kent sighed and looked in the direction of the Dwarves. They were also looking back at him.
To the Dwarves, who are the richest in the entire world, being allies with the Half-Elves is something they will benefit from.

When it comes to creating something out of nothing, they are the best, so this was basically a chance for them to ally with the Half-Elves and Kent Madson, knowing full well the Humans and the Half-Elves are not simple at all.
They will soon have access to all the resources they couldn’t obtain.

chapters.title: Chapter 758: First Step
paragraphs: From just a look, the Dwarves knew they had a chance, so they didn’t even have to learn how to approach the Half-Elves since the situation had already created itself.
King Brogan, alongside two elders, moved toward the Half-Elves.
’I guess the movies back on Earth didn’t exaggerate them. They are indeed a race that likes to grow their beards.’
Kent noticed this and couldn’t help but smile inwardly. The Dwarves are just as they were described in the movies.
They have muscular physiques, toned brown skin for most, and a height that shows—regardless of how long they live, increasing their height would just be impossible.
They approached King Thalirion and Queen Jascia, who received them with smiling faces.
"Good to see you again, King Thalirion, Queen Jascia," the Dwarf King said, keeping a smile on his face. Politics always involves knowing how to communicate and present oneself effectively.
Saying the wrong thing or exhibiting expressions that don’t conform to expectations often results in failed alliances.
Even if you have the best proposals, showing a hostile look during moments like this isn’t exactly the best approach. One ought to have a happy face and a polite smile.
"Good to see you too, King Brogan... I hope Queen Ylva is doing well," Queen Jascia asked, and the Dwarven king nodded.
"She is well. Of course, she was happy to hear you are back. I am even sure she will be visiting you before the auction."
Queen Jascia smiled, "I would love that."
The two elders standing behind the Dwarf King looked at Kent for a few seconds before shifting to Uncle Drake. In their heads, they also wondered the same thing the dragons did.
However, unlike the dragons, they don’t have that ego and arrogance, so they approached him. Their mission was to form that relationship with the Half-Elves.
It wasn’t to see if they could earn something, but rather to create the connection.
The main conversation will happen next time they meet. So they approached Uncle Drake and spoke in the most polite tone they could muster.

"If it isn’t too much to ask, what is this senior’s name, and where did he come from?" Elder Brynn asked. He is a bald dwarf with a green beard, standing about 4’3" in height and muscular by all standards.
"I am from the Hell Zone in the ancient battlefield of parting." Uncle Drake’s answer was short, but it caused those who heard it to break into a cold sweat.
Even the dragons were the same.
The Hell Zone, one of the seven unconquered regions in the ancient battlefield of parting.
The Dead Region, The Hell Zone, The Ancient Temple, The Haunted City, The Frozen Mountain, The Blood Desert, and finally, the Rib Dome City.

These are the seven unconquered zones in the Ancient Battlefield of Parting. Not even the Supreme Immortal Sect was able to conquer them, for they are some of the most dangerous places in the entire world.
Yet there is a being from that place, and looking at how he behaved toward the dragons, which everyone saw, he was indeed worthy of being a creature from there.
Of course, what Uncle Drake isn’t telling them is that he only lived in the outer reaches of the zone, where he mainly dealt with the humans who dared explore the Hell Zone.
When he left using a rift that opened one day, he appeared in the Beast Empire. He lived there for just 100 years and left because he didn’t feel at home there.
He left, and he began searching for more opportunities to grow stronger. One thing led to another, and he arrived in the Flame Valley.
So while he spent thousands of years in the Flame Valley, he had indeed come from the Hell Zone, where he planned to explore one of these days.
But for now, everyone became weary of the dragon standing with the Half-Elves. It was already enough for Kent to be associated with them.
Now, they have a dragon from the Hell Zone.
It was enough for them to think long and hard before doing something as stupid as being hostile toward the Half-Elves.
After Uncle Drake’s answer, the two elders seemed to recover, so they asked another question, and the answer was as everyone expected.
"I was happy to be offered a place to stay in Elarion, so I will be there for a while. It is quiet there and everyone is lovely."

"I bet you are right. However, you can come to Stoneforge one of these days, we will host you for a few days, and perhaps pick your brain more on things we should expect if we ever wanted to explore the Hell Zone."
"I will be sure to visit one of these days."
It was a short conversation, but the Dwarves were satisfied. Of course, before leaving, they left a goodwill gesture to show the Half-Elves their generosity.
King Brogan retrieved a red token and handed it to King Thalirion. "I couldn’t raise enough people to enter the Flame Tower this time, so you can have this one.
I learned you only have five, so perhaps this can allow one more of the impressive young geniuses behind you to enter the tower."
With a smile, they left, leaving the Queen and King with the same smile. As the Queen expected, bringing all seven Half-Elves wasn’t a bad idea.
Even if Arion, Helyra, and Cyran are more than 100 years old, it doesn’t necessarily mean they have to focus solely on the sect.
The 100-year requirement to enter the sect through the Flame Tower was a stipulation devised by the sect. So it doesn’t mean all those who can enter the sect have to be below 100 years old.
Some of the generals in the kingdoms entered the tower at some point just to master a flame art so they could protect their kingdoms well.

However, if the three Half-Elves manage to comprehend flame art, once Kent enters the sect, bringing them in won’t be too hard, for the sect will witness their strengths and recognize them as promising individuals.
The oldest among them is Arion, and he is 370 years old. That isn’t too old if everything is put into perspective.
The moment they left, Lord Qilin also approached the Half-Elves. As the leader of the beast race, he can decide for his people.

"Good to see you again, King Thalirion, Queen Jascia," the Dwarf King said, keeping a smile on his face.
Politics always involves knowing how to communicate and present oneself effectively.
Saying the wrong thing or exhibiting expressions that don’t conform to expectations often results in failed alliances.
Even if you have the best proposals, showing a hostile look during moments like this isn’t exactly the best approach.
One ought to have a happy face and a polite smile.
"Good to see you too, King Brogan...
I hope Queen Ylva is doing well," Queen Jascia asked, and the Dwarven king nodded.
"She is well.
Of course, she was happy to hear you are back.
I am even sure she will be visiting you before the auction."
Queen Jascia smiled, "I would love that."
The two elders standing behind the Dwarf King looked at Kent for a few seconds before shifting to Uncle Drake.
In their heads, they also wondered the same thing the dragons did.
However, unlike the dragons, they don’t have that ego and arrogance, so they approached him.
Their mission was to form that relationship with the Half-Elves.
It wasn’t to see if they could earn something, but rather to create the connection.
The main conversation will happen next time they meet.
So they approached Uncle Drake and spoke in the most polite tone they could muster.
"If it isn’t too much to ask, what is this senior’s name, and where did he come from?" Elder Brynn asked.
He is a bald dwarf with a green beard, standing about 4’3" in height and muscular by all standards.
"I am from the Hell Zone in the ancient battlefield of parting." Uncle Drake’s answer was short, but it caused those who heard it to break into a cold sweat.
Even the dragons were the same.
The Hell Zone, one of the seven unconquered regions in the ancient battlefield of parting.
The Dead Region, The Hell Zone, The Ancient Temple, The Haunted City, The Frozen Mountain, The Blood Desert, and finally, the Rib Dome City.
These are the seven unconquered zones in the Ancient Battlefield of Parting.
Not even the Supreme Immortal Sect was able to conquer them, for they are some of the most dangerous places in the entire world.
Yet there is a being from that place, and looking at how he behaved toward the dragons, which everyone saw, he was indeed worthy of being a creature from there.
Of course, what Uncle Drake isn’t telling them is that he only lived in the outer reaches of the zone, where he mainly dealt with the humans who dared explore the Hell Zone.
When he left using a rift that opened one day, he appeared in the Beast Empire.
He lived there for just 100 years and left because he didn’t feel at home there.
He left, and he began searching for more opportunities to grow stronger.
One thing led to another, and he arrived in the Flame Valley.
So while he spent thousands of years in the Flame Valley, he had indeed come from the Hell Zone, where he planned to explore one of these days.
But for now, everyone became weary of the dragon standing with the Half-Elves.
It was already enough for Kent to be associated with them.
Now, they have a dragon from the Hell Zone.
It was enough for them to think long and hard before doing something as stupid as being hostile toward the Half-Elves.
After Uncle Drake’s answer, the two elders seemed to recover, so they asked another question, and the answer was as everyone expected.
"I was happy to be offered a place to stay in Elarion, so I will be there for a while.
It is quiet there and everyone is lovely."
"I bet you are right.
However, you can come to Stoneforge one of these days, we will host you for a few days, and perhaps pick your brain more on things we should expect if we ever wanted to explore the Hell Zone."
"I will be sure to visit one of these days."
It was a short conversation, but the Dwarves were satisfied.
Of course, before leaving, they left a goodwill gesture to show the Half-Elves their generosity.
King Brogan retrieved a red token and handed it to King Thalirion.
"I couldn’t raise enough people to enter the Flame Tower this time, so you can have this one.
I learned you only have five, so perhaps this can allow one more of the impressive young geniuses behind you to enter the tower."
With a smile, they left, leaving the Queen and King with the same smile.
As the Queen expected, bringing all seven Half-Elves wasn’t a bad idea.
Even if Arion, Helyra, and Cyran are more than 100 years old, it doesn’t necessarily mean they have to focus solely on the sect.
The 100-year requirement to enter the sect through the Flame Tower was a stipulation devised by the sect.
So it doesn’t mean all those who can enter the sect have to be below 100 years old.
Some of the generals in the kingdoms entered the tower at some point just to master a flame art so they could protect their kingdoms well.

However, if the three Half-Elves manage to comprehend flame art, once Kent enters the sect, bringing them in won’t be too hard, for the sect will witness their strengths and recognize them as promising individuals.
The oldest among them is Arion, and he is 370 years old.
That isn’t too old if everything is put into perspective.
The moment they left, Lord Qilin also approached the Half-Elves.
As the leader of the beast race, he can decide for his people.

chapters.title: Chapter 759: Making Headway
paragraphs: Lord Qilin is a handsome and graceful man.
He has deep blue, flowing hair and an appearance that suggests he is in his late 40s, while in fact, he is over ten thousand years old.
He has an athletic build, and, like every Qilin in their human form, he has subtle, shimmering scales on his arms and neck.
With him came two others, also from the Qilin race. They are the two strongest elders in the Qilin Court.
Just like with the Dwarves, they approached the Half-Elves with polite smiles.
"King Thalirion. Queen Jascia. Pleasure to meet you all again."
"Glad to see you too, Lord Qilin. I was told you managed to shut that Hand lady up while I was away. Nice one, Lord Qilin," Queen Jascia said with a smile.
Kent, who heard her words, knew she wanted to call the leader of the Hand a bitch. However, to maintain her dignity and stellar reputation, she had to make compromises.
However, hearing that the Hand was overpowered by Lord Qilin, who even went ahead and stripped her cultivation base by four refining levels, made her very happy.
Of course, the Qilin aren’t known for their dominance if their emperor can’t even handle some arrogant bitch who seeks to suppress them.
He made sure she became aware of what he stood for, and that wasn’t to become the worker of an underworld organization.

Just like how the dragons made sure she knew they didn’t want to go into league with her like she wanted, the Qilin made sure she knew they honestly did not want to do anything she had in mind for the Beastkins.

Of course, other beast races still went into bed with her and, for the last years, had been doing her bidding. But for now, the Beast Race has no connection to the Hand when viewed from Lord Qilin’s perspective.
"I guess if the Warrior Queen herself acknowledged my feat, then I should be happy about it. Though I also heard the Hand lost hundreds of their best in your kingdom. That is impressive too."
Both King Thalirion and Queen Jascia smiled, and King Thalirion responded, "While it would be good to claim credit, that feat wasn’t achieved by us but by Kent Madson.
He was the one who killed every last one of them, including Kenji, the Blade Whisperer, who had been under the command of the hand all this while."
Lord Qilin looked at Kent and smiled, though Kent could see the doubts in his eyes.
Not that he expected just anyone to believe he was able to kill hundreds of the Hand operatives, and even went as far as killing Kenji, the most wanted killer in world.
After all, someone like him doesn’t exactly scream fear.
"I guess thanks are in order for doing all of us a great service, taking out the scum that has haunted most of us for years."
Kent merely nodded, not having much interest in whatever Lord Qilin thinks of him. Ultimately, he doesn’t seek validation from anyone.
Those who have doubts about him will try to come against him, and he will be forced to kill them all.
For now, everyone can think what they want.
"We would like to officially make you aware that every last Beastkin will send representatives to the auction. I hope we are welcome," Lord Qilin said after a few bickering exchanges here and there.
Of course, this was his way of letting the Half-Elves know they had accepted the invitation and would be coming to the auction.
This way, on the very day of the auction, even if there were any new changes, asking now means it wouldn’t affect them.
"We will be sure to welcome you all with open arms," King Thalirion said, bringing a smile to Lord Qilin’s face.

"In that case, we will come early so we can explore your humble kingdom before the auction." He turned to leave, but then he stopped and, turning around with a smile, he extended his hand and handed over two red tokens to King Thalirion.
"Take that as a sign of goodwill for this newly formed relationship between our kingdoms." With that, he left, making the Half-Elves smile slightly.

’Bunch of pretenders pretending to care when they just want what we have. Of course, when we are done with them, they will know a Half-Elf is not an easy target,’ Queen Jascia said inwardly, looking at Lord Qilin retreating.
If she were to be sincere, then she would say only the Dwarves are worthy of her respect, for they were their allies in a way.

She and the queen of the Dwarves are friends to some extent, who, back in the day, shared some happy moments. Had it not been for Queen Ylva, when Kenji’s dagger pierced Queen Jascia’s chest, she would have died.
But Queen Ylva used one of her most fabulous creations to save her, and for that, she is grateful.
Even if the last 1,000 years hadn’t seen the Dwarves helping the Half-Elves, if anything, at the end of the day, they saved their queen, so that counted for something.
However, the others merely want to use the Half-Elves, and when they have obtained what they want, they will reveal their true colors.
That is the worst kind of evil, and they are ensuring its success. However, the Half-Elves are also not going to reveal their true nature until it is necessary.
Queen Elenara was seething in anger while she watched the races she had a good relationship with now sucking up to the Half-Elves.

If anything, she most certainly would want the Half-Elves to drop dead, for she didn’t like what she was after to be discovered by them. But now, she was starting to suspect the Half-Elves wouldn’t be in the dark for long.
That both made her weary and pissed off like hell.
Kent was also now more focused on something else, and that was the demons.
The Blood Demons, in particular, were looking at him with extreme killing intent. It was as if, at any moment, they would lunge at him.
’Why not ask them what they want?’ Kent smiled in his head. He looked toward the Blood Demon King and asked,
"Excuse me, Mr. I don’t suppose we met before, or we share the same parents, so why then are you looking at me with extreme killing intent?"

chapters.title: Chapter 760: Not Afraid [Bonus]
paragraphs: All the noise died down when Kent asked the question.
They all turned to the Blood Demon King, who, for a moment, looked surprised, then a frown appeared on his face.
"What did you just say?" he asked, emitting a faint killing intent that was now visible to everyone. Initially, his killing intent was directed at Kent, making only him capable of sensing it.
But now, he had made his intentions known. He wanted to see an intimidated look on Kent’s face, but all he saw was defiance. That alone pissed him off.
Kent doesn’t hold him in high esteem, which to someone like him was a huge insult.
Kent looked at him for a few seconds and smirked.
"I said what I said and I meant every last word. Why the hell are you looking at me with killing intent like I stole your wife?"
The aura around the Blood Demon King intensified just watching Kent’s smug expression. Of course, no matter how much he wanted to see Kent panic, nothing of the sort happened.
It was like Kent didn’t even see him as a threat.
"Save yourself the struggle, for even if there are ten of you, I wouldn’t even have to raise my hand to kill you.
That said, I want to make it clear that my conflict lies with the Hand; if you choose to become their dogs and attack me, then I will defend myself.
Defending myself will likely result in bloodshed, and while I would love to avoid that, blood doesn’t scare me.
So, while I am still smiling, take my advice and save yourself and your people."
Subtle.
Kent’s threat was subtle at best, but it contained an underlying menace, one that made everyone aware of his stance.
Kent isn’t against them. If anything, he wants them all to succeed, just as he wants the Half-Elves to. He doesn’t want to destroy; instead, he plans to build the various races in Sonox.
He knew what he would gain from that in the long run, so that was his aim.
To him, the Hand is his only enemy worth paying attention to. So while he would love to have a peaceful life with everyone, he also plans to make them aware that they are not his enemies.
His enemy is the Hand, so if anyone were to ally with them, they would also become his enemy.
He made the Half-Elves aware of this, and he was ensuring the others became aware of it too.
His words resonated with them. He could see the looks that appeared in their eyes and plastered on their faces.
They sensed it. They felt it. And they knew it.

The brat standing before them is not afraid of them. Not even one bit. If anything, Kent was saving himself the struggle because to him, killing even a single one of them would be a waste of soul essence.
He values every last one of them because they are potential soul essence.
Before coming to this part of the world, he had plans to commit a couple of massacres on an unprecedented level.
He was prepared to kill.
However, when he saved the three Half-Elves, his plans changed accordingly.
He saw his future linked to millions of worlds. He saw Galaxies, comprising thousands of star systems and planetary alliances, all connected to him, empowering him.
He saw an endless supply of soul essence.
When Paragon gave him the ’Soul Universe’ technique, he told him that if he managed to walk the path to the peak, then in all of existence, nobody could measure up to him.

Kent wanted that. He had already glimpsed his past lives, and what he saw terrified him, so he planned to make his life in this life much more impressive. He planned to grow several times stronger this time.

This time, he planned not to fail. He planned to make his presence a source of hope for the hopeless. And to do that, he needed people. But to need people is to kill those who want to waste human life.
The Hand is that evil that wants to waste the life he needed. So he will do what he does best and unleash chaos on all those who come against what he cherishes.
"Let me be honest with you all. There is no outcome where any of you succeed in killing me. If anything, I am more impressed that I won’t even struggle against any of you.
But that doesn’t mean I am supreme and can easily trump over you all. However, you wouldn’t want to put that to the test.
None of you knows anything about me. Where I came from, who backs me, or what I am capable of. But the same cannot be said for you.

I know everything, and while I am not the kind that likes to use underhanded means, I also wouldn’t hesitate to use any underhanded means to destroy you. So please, for your sake, back down while you still have a chance."

Kent then turned to the Blood Demon King specifically. "The one who foils your plans in the Dead Region is looking for blood. I can perhaps cool her down. Of course, you can be arrogant and say whatever you want.
But know this, if she wants you all gone, she will be able to do it within an hour. Perhaps, the only reason she hasn’t yet is because I told her not to.

So, yet again, behave yourself, or you won’t only be dooming yourself, but your entire race as well. As for what you’re after, I have dozens of ways to help you achieve it, but that will depend on what happens in the next few days.
If I see you worthy, I will do my best to help you; otherwise, I will allow whatever Karma you have accumulated to explode in your faces.
That will be all. Now, if you don’t mind me, you can go on with what you were doing before this unfortunate moment."
Words are indeed powerful. With just a few lines, one can shatter the ideas of many. Kent had just used words to shatter the ideas of the demon race.
’Mother would have been proud of me,’ Kent smiled in his head.

If he went ahead and wiped out the demon race, the rest would fall in line and fear him like the plague. But he didn’t do that. He used his words, and the outcome was exactly how he had expected it to be.
They are afraid of him, and he can see that. In a way, they are now more than ever weary of the one called Kent Madson.
Some started asking the questions that they should have asked when the Hand came to them to help kill Kent.
They never even wondered about that, for the rewards offered were just too enticing. But now, it was plain to them that Kent Madson is no simple person.
And now that they see that, they would be forced to think logically instead of diving headfirst into anything that will invite doom for everyone.
Like Kent said, they don’t know him or have any idea of his background. That alone is enough for them to start thinking logically now.
After all, while they can’t get to the other worlds, they are more than aware there are worlds out there. Who is to say he isn’t some big shot’s son from an even more powerful world than their own?
