chapters.title: Chapter 761: Reps From The Sect
paragraphs: After Kent’s vivid and clear display of dominance using just his words, a sense of calm returned to the place, and everyone entered a state of contemplation about what Kent had just said.
There was just something about the way Kent spoke that made them listen. His words reached them, and even those who didn’t want to listen were compelled to hear him.
It was just too bizarre, but the state of Flame Mountain was calm.
Meanwhile, Kent was talking to his goddess.
[I was lost in the moment and forgot to check on the eight new undead. However, don’t worry; you can proceed to the third floor when you’re ready.
The eight undead will be added once I am out of the Flame Tower.]
"Don’t worry about us. Just focus on yourself," Vexthra responded, and Kent smiled inwardly.
[By the way, have you found anything else on the second floor?] Kent asked. The ladies were still on the second floor, exploring everywhere.
Since they gained a lot from the first floor, they were now trying to see if they could gain anything else from the second floor.
"We have already explored 80% of the second floor, and aside from a few ancient texts that only Unity can translate, we have yet to find anything in the lines of a skill, technique, or whatever.
Of course, we have marked everything on the map so later you can explore it and see if you can make heads or tails of everything."
Vexthra was meticulous about the entire process, ensuring that everything was marked for later reference.
Kent most certainly would love to explore every section of the floors, for he knew it had something to do with his past one way or another.

[Don’t worry too much about digging for everything now. A time will come when you will have to relax. You can use that time to conduct further research. For now, handle the most essential and let me know how it goes.
Also, in case you can’t reach me in the next three days, don’t panic.]
"Okay. Talk to you later," Vexthra cut the connection and went back to exploring the second floor.
Meanwhile, Kent turned back to the half-elves. "Looks like we are all entering the tower."
They nodded.
With the dwarves giving them one slot and Lord Qilin giving them two, Arion, Helyra, and Cyran would be entering the Flame Tower with them.
This was beneficial for them. Kent knew they had come a long way thanks to the grueling training they underwent inside the Flame Valley.
It has molded, refined, and built them to handle whatever the Flame Tower throws at them.
Kent had already managed to help them raise their souls to Tier 12, just one step away from reaching his level.

Of course, the resources needed to reach that stage would cost him billions in tower points, so he planned to give them a soul technique like he did with his ladies. They can handle the rest on their own.

In fact, he discovered something that inspired him to invest his energy in them. After adding the seven half-elves to the Guardian Hand, he saw a leap in the amount of soul essence he was receiving from them.
It was now 1.5 times the initial amount, and he knew that after they emerged from the tower, it would increase again.
Kent deduced that the people he added to the Guardian Hand affect the amount of soul essence he could earn from a race he added to the Guardian Tower.
The stronger the ten get, the more soul essence he will receive.
This meant that if he were to go back to Fedora and add ten people to the Guardian Hand, the amount of soul essence he received from them would increase exponentially.

It was a good thing for him because, regardless of what happened, he would be able to increase his strength forever by just ensuring that ten people out of millions never slacked off on their training.
’Imagine all of them becoming gods one day. I will probably be earning so much that building an asteroid could happen within seconds.’

Kent smiled. "Since we are all entering the Flame Tower, I expect each of you to come out with at least two flame arts mastered. Anything less and you will spend ten days in the core region of the Flame Valley."
They laughed happily, knowing full well that the brat would actually do it.
During their time at the Flame Valley, Kent pushed them all to their limits, and only when they were at their breaking points did he intervene.
If he were able to do that, then he would be able to do worse later.
A while later, the shadow demon king and his elders also came and, just like the others, left by giving a slot to the half-elves, meaning the princess would also be able to enter.
The last to come were the dragons, who, although still prideful, understood it was the least they could do. However, the queen politely rejected the offer by asking for the slot in three years.
This was received well by the dragons. After all, if they had indeed given a slot to the half-elves, that meant one of their best and brightest wouldn’t be able to enter the Flame Tower.
Of course, if Uncle Drake had wanted to enter, Queen Jascia would have accepted the slot. However, the Flame King said he already had a flame art, so he passed up the offer.
After a while, everyone started to relax. However, it didn’t take long for the main people everyone was there to meet to appear.
The void cracked open, and a man clad in green robes appeared through the cracks, exuding a rather potent aura. Kent raised his eyebrows when he saw the man.
But he wasn’t the only one who came. Behind him were two young individuals. One was a young man with short blonde hair, handsome by some standards, and the lady was also cute but with wavy blue hair.
They were both clad in green robes just like the man. Of course, their auras weren’t any weaker than the man’s, who was an elder.
They were the representatives from the Supreme Immortal Sect, the main attraction at events like this.
The moment they appeared and hovered in the air, looking down at everyone, Kent immediately knew they didn’t see them as worthy beings, not even in the slightest.
However, when their eyes landed on Uncle Drake, he saw a flicker appear in all three of their eyes.
’Interesting...’

chapters.title: Chapter 762: True Dragons’ Arrogance
paragraphs: Kent studied the three new arrivals, and a smirk appeared on his lips, but only for a moment. He didn’t want to become arrogant, just as those he had been waiting for had arrived.

The first to appear wasn’t that old. He is in his late 50s and called Elder Lance from the Alchemy Hall in the outer region of the Supreme Immortal Sect. The two with him were also from the outer region but were disciples, Pill disciples, hence the green robes.
They looked down at the various kingdom leaders with no sign of respect in their eyes. If anything, it was the leaders who looked at them with expressions of reverence.
But Kent saw they were paying attention to one person.
They were looking at Uncle Drake, who, just as he looked at everyone, watched them with no sign of fear or respect.
Of course, this look didn’t sit well with the three arrivals. They expected everyone to look at them with respect, but Uncle Drake was making them look like just anyone.
’This should be good.’
Kent slowly stepped aside as the show of arrogance began.
"Who are you?" the elder asked, looking at Uncle Drake as if he would swallow him. Uncle Drake stared at him for a few seconds before responding.
"Nobody."
Those words weren’t received well. And Kent, who knew what was about to happen, stepped aside further, making sure he was far from the impact zone.
BAM!

A palm strike came from the male disciple, landing where Uncle Drake stood. Dust rose into the air, creating an opaque aura that obscured everyone’s vision. Of course, they relaxed as the aftermath of the attack awaited judgment.
"How dare you disrespect an elder from the Supreme Immortal Sect?" The young male disciple shouted.
All around, everyone’s eyes were locked on the place where Uncle Drake had stood, waiting for the dust to clear.

They all expected that attack because it wasn’t the first time it had happened. A while back, something similar happened to the Dragons, resulting in the deaths of three elders from the Earth Dragon and Flame Dragon races that day.
So the moment they looked at Uncle Drake, everyone knew what was about to happen. They expected it, and it happened.
However, after years of being disrespected by representatives from the Supreme Immortal Sect, the script had flipped.
While everyone was looking at where the attack landed, Kent smirked, knowing Uncle Drake had long since made his move.
"What makes you think I care whether or not you are from that sect..." The voice came from behind the disciple who attacked, and before he could move, a firm grip grabbed hold of his neck.

But that wasn’t all; the moment Uncle Drake grabbed him, a powerful force emanated from his body, forcing the elder and the lady disciple to drop hard to the ground, landing on their knees immediately.
Chills ran down everyone’s spine when they saw this.
Of course, aside from the two who were affected, just the shockwave was enough to force the others back several meters.
Uncle Drake dangled the brat in his grip and looked lazily at the Aelder lance. "I don’t care who you are or where you come from.
You are here for a reason, so am I. So, before you expect me to show you respect, show yourself some respect. Acting like you are above all else is simply foolish.
Countless people in this world are much more impressive than you. I know this because I am better than you and will always remain so.
So you may act all high and mighty, but keep that inside your precious sect, not out here.
I will not be lenient next time."
With that, he let go of the male disciple, who crashed to the ground, passing out immediately. Uncle Drake looked lazily around, and when he locked eyes with Kent, a smile appeared on his lips.
Kent gave him a slight nod.
Then, with a wave of his hand, the void cracked, and he vanished inside. It was only when he left that the pressure vanished.

’Nicely done, Uncle Drake. Now, I want to see what they’ll do after this humiliation.’ Kent was rather happy after Uncle Drake thumped the dignity of the overly arrogant reps from the Supreme Immortal Sect.
All three of them were humans, which looked strange. But in a way, Kent connected the dots, and the answer was quite simple.
Sonox is part of the Celestial Conclave planetary alliance, which comprises 64 worlds. It was only natural for humans from this world to come to this one.
Of course, the only reason they would come here was if the sect was as impressive as they said. There are 64 worlds, and Kent knew there would be 64 powerful sects, each representing a world.
So if Sonox were in the top ten best sects, ultimately, those who ranked below them would seek to come and grow under the banner of Sonox.
Seeing humans was normal, but Kent knew they weren’t from Sonox right away after scanning them, of course.

Watching the elder and the lady disciple stand up after Uncle Drake left was rather satisfying to watch. Inwardly, the world leaders were already planning to thank Uncle Drake when they saw him again.
He restored their pride, and while they knew news of this wouldn’t be heard by anyone from the sect, it was good to watch.

The reps didn’t even have the chance to boost before Uncle Drake shut them up, and looking at them now, Kent knew they wouldn’t be able to do anything ever again. The face they lost could not be replaced, and they knew that.
’They are strong, that one is true. Even as an alchemist, their strength level is very impressive. But Uncle Drake is on another level.

His strength is terrifying. So these three would be traumatized for a while. I hope more of them will be in the sect so I can shut them up too. For now, the plan is to get into the sect by being impressive."
A few minutes after Uncle Drake entered the void, the mountain vibrated and the sea of lava surged, filling the space with potent heat.
The shaking lasted for a few minutes, then it stopped. However, the moment it stopped, a giant tower rose from the ground and ascended into the air, standing about 500 meters tall.
The tower seemed to exude a rather potent flame energy, one that made Kent smile. He could already feel his body craving the heat.

chapters.title: Chapter 763: Rules and Nature of the Flame Tower [Bonus]
paragraphs: The tower stood tall, imposing and powerful just from its look.
It seemed to be built from metals dripping red with lava.
It was built like a box, but it had shapes, jagged yet intricate, that revealed it was made with great attention to detail. It was built to command attention.
These designs gave the tower a fierce, almost primal elegance—a fortress both brutal and refined, crafted with meticulous attention to detail.
’Whoever this immortal was, he knew what he was doing. The tower looks both simple, complex, and elegant at the same time.’
The aura surrounding it thrummed with power, and just by gazing upon it, Kent could feel the immense strength locked within its walls.
’I can’t wait to enter,’ Kent said inwardly as he gazed at the towering structure pulsing with energy.
A few minutes after the tower appeared, Elder Lance flew into the air, looking more tame after the humiliation Uncle Drake put him through.
Of course, just because a true dragon tamed him doesn’t mean he was suddenly overpowered and broken. Now, among the world leaders, none dared to make any attempt to add more salt to the wound.
If anything, they were even calmer and quieter, knowing the humiliation Uncle Drake had put him through. He would want to redeem his ego by getting back at someone.
So they all gave him some face and remained respectful, just as they had before the unfortunate incident.

"Listen up," Elder Lance began. "The tower has awakened, and like every three years, those with a token can enter. If you try to sneak into it without a token, I don’t suppose I have to tell you what would happen.
Now, let’s go over the rules.
First, do not think of wanting to fight or sneak attack while inside. Any attempt to attack anyone means instant death.
And while it will be worth it if you die with the one you sneak attack on, that won’t be the case because even if the person dies, the tower will use your life force to save them.
This means you will be dying a foolish death.
Second, you have only three days to comprehend a flame art. After three days, you will be kicked out, and if you fail to reach the third form of the technique, it will be wiped from your mind.
This means don’t try to memorize because it won’t work. Master the technique, or more like learn and understand the first three forms, before the three days are over.
Third, avoid trying to play smart and think you can use soul items to record techniques in hopes of learning from them later.
You will not only lose your soul item, but the tower will place a limit on you, which will prevent you from comprehending any flame-related skill ever again.
Lastly, you have the privilege to learn as many techniques as you can from the teacher, provided you can master the first three forms of the technique.
Please note that the reason I am here is to select the best geniuses and report their performance to the sect. In a week, you will be invited to take the sect exams.
So this is your chance to prove to everyone how impressive you are because trust me, you will need it now more than ever."

Everyone sighed, knowing their one shot to enter the sect was about to be determined in 72 hours. If they blew it, then that would be on them. But if they managed to get it done, they were one step away from entering the strongest sect in the world.
It was a big gamble, one that depended on their performance upon entering the tower.
"Now let’s talk about the nature of the tower." Kent’s attention was pulled into what Elder Lance was about to say, for that was the main thing he was waiting for.
The rules aren’t something he has to know, for he isn’t planning on ruining the experience by cheating.
He had already planned to get things done faster, so stabbing someone in the back wasn’t something he planned on doing.
"The tower is simple. When you enter, you will appear at the foot of a long stairway. All you have to do is start to climb.
However, it isn’t as simple as it sounds. You see, the reason we call it Flame Tower is that inside the tower, it’s as hot as hell.
And when I say hot like hell, I mean every single word. The higher you climb, the hotter it gets until your skin literally starts to burn and peel off.
However, you have to climb because it is through climbing that you will earn the techniques you can try to master.
The stairway has five levels. Every level has 100 steps. To master a technique, you must climb 100 steps and reach the first level, which grants access to Heaven-grade techniques.
At least you should be able to climb this far because although Heaven grade isn’t that strong, they are flame-type skills, meaning the more you understand the flame, the stronger they become.
Also, having a stronger soul flame will boost the technique’s potency. You will have the option to select as many as you can, and the moment you master at least three forms, you can move to the next.

The following 100 steps lead to level 2, where you will be presented with various Legendary-grade techniques. You have to know that mastering at least three forms of a technique here will take you a long way when you get into the sect.
Level 3 has Mystical-grade skills. If you manage to acquire mystical-grade techniques, then you know you have a future as an Inner Disciple.

Then there is level 4, where only Mythic-grade techniques can be found. In the history of the Flame Tower, only four people have managed to master a technique from there, and they are all now core disciples.
Of course, I don’t want to look down on you, so measure your coat according to your size.

For level 5, I cannot say what is there, but if you don’t burn to ashes, then perhaps you will be presented with divine-grade techniques, something that not even the supreme immortal sect can boast of having more than just ten of.
That is all when it comes to how you will be getting a technique from the tower.

Of course, you can be brave and brave the heat, but know that death is permanent, so before getting greedy, remember that death is only once and cannot be bought with money." Elder Lance looked at everyone and smirked, his arrogance returning.
"Now, if you have a question, you can ask."
Kent stepped forward and asked,

The stairway has five levels.
Every level has 100 steps.
To master a technique, you must climb 100 steps and reach the first level, which grants access to Heaven-grade techniques.
At least you should be able to climb this far because although Heaven grade isn’t that strong, they are flame-type skills, meaning the more you understand the flame, the stronger they become.
Also, having a stronger soul flame will boost the technique’s potency.
You will have the option to select as many as you can, and the moment you master at least three forms, you can move to the next.
The following 100 steps lead to level 2, where you will be presented with various Legendary-grade techniques.
You have to know that mastering at least three forms of a technique here will take you a long way when you get into the sect.
Level 3 has Mystical-grade skills.
If you manage to acquire mystical-grade techniques, then you know you have a future as an Inner Disciple.
Then there is level 4, where only Mythic-grade techniques can be found.
In the history of the Flame Tower, only four people have managed to master a technique from there, and they are all now core disciples.
Of course, I don’t want to look down on you, so measure your coat according to your size.

For level 5, I cannot say what is there, but if you don’t burn to ashes, then perhaps you will be presented with divine-grade techniques, something that not even the supreme immortal sect can boast of having more than just ten of.
That is all when it comes to how you will be getting a technique from the tower.

Of course, you can be brave and brave the heat, but know that death is permanent, so before getting greedy, remember that death is only once and cannot be bought with money." Elder Lance looked at everyone and smirked, his arrogance returning.
"Now, if you have a question, you can ask."
Kent stepped forward and asked,

chapters.title: Chapter 764: Entering the Flame Tower
paragraphs: Elder Lance was clearly shocked when he finally noticed that Kent was a human.

He hadn’t paid much attention to anyone aside from Uncle Drake when he first arrived. But now that he did, he was shaken a little, for he was told no human had ever entered the Flame Tower since its emergence.

’Supreme Elder Jian clearly said the humans regressed after the war, and so in the world of Sonox, the humans are trash. However, looking at this kid now, I don’t think that deduction about them is correct.
He looked calm, confident, and almost aloof despite staring me in the eye. If I didn’t know better, I would say he is even more arrogant than the dragon from before.’
He looked at Kent for a moment.
’But he looks innocent, and from the look in his eyes, respectful even.’ His deduction of Kent was high, just as the brat wanted it to be.
He doesn’t know much about his life as the Faceless assassin, but when it comes to playing a character, nobody can surpass him.
A small smile appeared on Elder Lance’s face. He was clearly proud that a fellow human would be entering the Flame Tower.
’I must ensure he makes it into the sect if he manages to comprehend just one flame technique regardless of the grade." With that thought, he gestured for Kent to ask his question.
Kent nodded with a smile playing on his lips. ’And the Oscar goes to Kent Madson.’
His act was bought, and now that he managed to find himself in the good books of Elder Lance, he could only look forward to what he had planned next.

"I want to ask," Kent began his question, "Let’s say I manage to climb to the third floor but can’t push any further. Can I come back down and try comprehending techniques on the second and first floors?"
"Of course you can. Provided you walked through a level, you can return later to try to comprehend the techniques it offers.
However, be warned: you have only three days to learn the technique. Don’t aim too high and end up losing everything."
Elder Lance saw Kent still had more questions, so he gestured for him to ask.
"Say I have a pill that will boost my cognitive strength, which in this way will enhance my comprehension speed. Am I allowed to use it while inside the tower?"
This question was, of course, on the minds of many, so they paid attention to the Elder, who smiled and answered.

"Of course you can take it. The aim here is to master a technique to at least the first three forms. So, as long as you don’t try recording, using any means to boost your mental strength to handle the task is allowed."
"Thank you," Kent nodded and moved back to his original position. Elder Lance nodded and turned to the door of the Flame Tower, still shut.
He produced a medallion and made it fly toward the gate. A few seconds later, the tower shuddered.
"Be prepared, the door opens in five."

Every leader turned to the youngsters they would be sending into the Flame Tower and began giving them fine advice on how to gain the most from the 72 days they would stay inside the Flame Tower, left behind by an unknown immortal said to hold supreme understanding of the flame.
Kent turned to the seven half-elves and the princess.
"This is it, guys," he smiled. "Entering the tower now means you either open the path to your future or you blow it and come crashing on your face entirely.
However, I know you guys won’t come crashing. You have already gained more than enough to make it to at least the 4th floor."

The smiles on the faces of the half-elves faltered, hearing Kent’s unbelievable expectation. Though it sounded like a compliment, they couldn’t shake the feeling that Kent truly wanted them to reach the 4th level.
Only four people ever made it there, and now, Kent wanted them to get there.
"Don’t frown. All the treasure you ate over the past week wasn’t for nothing. It was to prepare you for this moment. Soon, when you enter the tower, you will understand what I mean.
Of course, I already told you to take the pill when you reach your breaking point. Trust me, getting to the 4th floor should be a priority because it wouldn’t only be about learning techniques.
It would also help you enhance your flame resistance, improve your comprehension, and even temper your soul flames.
If you play your cards right, the techniques will become a secondary thing to you. So trust in yourself and you will walk out smiling."
They nodded at his words. The past week inside the Flame Valley hadn’t been for nothing. Kent, who knew how important the Guardian hand was, had done his best to groom them.
In a way, he made sure he invested in them, and the moment they managed to walk out with their shoulders high, he would know his investment was worth it.
Elder Lance watched Kent’s back as he talked to the half-elves like they were his team.
’Looks like his background isn’t simple. To be the one coaching the half-elves, it seems they hold him in high esteem.’
With that thought, he waited for the countdown to reach zero, when the giant gate opened wide, allowing a wave of infernal energy to gush out.
Everyone stepped back a few steps, feeling the intense heat. Kent felt the energy wash over his skin, and his body visibly shuddered excitedly.
A giant panel appeared, looking blank at the moment.
"You all can enter now. Know that your names will be recorded here based on the number of techniques you master, the number of forms mastered, their grades, and the level you’ve reached.
As always, the sect will reward the race of the persons who manage to come up first, second, and third. That said, good luck and may you come out smiling."
With that signal, everyone started entering.
The dragons entered first, followed by the elves, then the beasts, demons, and dwarves. Kent held his token and turned to his pals.

"Good luck, everyone." With that, they all disappeared into the swirling infernal portal that took them to the first step of the Giant Hell Stairway, one of the Ancient immortal relics from the primordial era.

chapters.title: Chapter 765: Start To Climb
paragraphs: Kent walked through the gates of the tower with a calm expression and steady steps.

Walking through the gate, he felt a powerful presence wash over him. It felt soothing yet strong and dangerous. However, when the presence found he held a token, the token just vanished, and Kent appeared inside.
’Looks like medium worlds aren’t as simple as I thought. Vexthra already said sending me to a medium world has a reason behind it. I think this is one of them.’
He was ready for it.
He had already prepared for every path this journey would take him while he waited for the apocalypse gates to open.
Kent, just like everyone else, appeared at the first step of the giant tower. It looked impossible, extending several steps high.
"This is it, huh?" Norion said, looking at Kent.
"Indeed. Like we discussed, focus on climbing, adapting, and improving yourself first. The techniques will come naturally when you are ready."
They nodded, and Kent nodded back.
Already, many were on the 30th step and moving while they remained on the first step for 10 minutes. Only then did Kent gesture for them to move.
"Only take the pill when you genuinely can’t move again."

They nodded and started to climb. The first few steps wouldn’t be a problem for them. Kent watched them go and nodded with satisfaction. He waited for a couple of minutes before he was ready to climb.
’Alright. Time to break the Flame Tower.’
Kent moved and started climbing, just like everyone else. The steps were large enough to accommodate hundreds of climbers.

So he moved, and soon he was on the 20th step. The infernal energy on the step kept increasing as he moved, but it wasn’t to the point he couldn’t handle, since even on the 20th step, the flame energy there couldn’t be compared to the inner region of the Flame Valley.
Kent had to keep moving, watching as the energy in the space rose and continued to rise until he began to feel something.
It was then he noticed he had reached the 50th step.
Of course, he was still the last on the steps, but Kent didn’t mind.
His plans for entering the tower extended further than merely gaining some techniques. His plans revolved around the fact that all the youngsters on the steps were potential soul essence.
With the addition of [Guardian Hand] and [Guardian Allies], he soon realized he would have to make a few more people his allies, which to him went far beyond mere companions.
To him, this would be a way to increase the soul essence they would be giving him. He wasn’t looking to make everyone inside the flame tower his ally.
The plan is to see those with whom he resonates. He felt something when he met the three half-elves, and the same happened when he met Uncle Drake.
So he was looking to find more. Of course, he has the means to help all of them. But Kent is no charity work. He only helps those he wants and ignores those he doesn’t need.
A dragon can only be generous to some extent. This time, he planned to strengthen himself to the point that High Worlds wouldn’t be a threat to him.
For now, Spirit Lord and Heavenly Ascension stage experts were still outside his reach, but Kent knew that to live the life he wanted for himself, he had to bridge that gap somehow.

The ’Soul Universe’ was the answer on one hand, and his ’Primal Chaos Body Tempering Art’ was another. Not forgetting his Claw Art, which he had yet to learn. If anything, Kent was already making headway.
But more soul essence wouldn’t hurt.
Soon, he was on the 60th step, and that was when he saw some people struggling on the 80th floor. They wanted to sweat, but their sweat was being dried as it came.
It was the bitter kind of frustration they were going through.
"Weaklings. They couldn’t even get to the first level without making it look too obvious," Kent smirked, watching them slowly move, putting all their effort into at least getting to the first level.

If they got there, their chances of learning a heavenly-grade technique would be determined by how determined they were. But if they couldn’t even get to the first floor, then they were already a waste.
Kent kept watching their backs as he closed in on them within a minute. Soon, he passed them, looking ahead at the first floor, where he saw a few standing, looking through dozens of small tomes.
Those who knew it wasn’t worth it to brave the second floor chose to bug out now and focus on the heavenly-grade techniques.
Some just wanted a contingency plan in case they couldn’t handle the second floor and end up wasting their own time. Learning a Heaven grade technique isn’t bad for them.

Another group was merely looking through the techniques while relaxing for a few minutes before climbing again. It had already been 30 minutes since the gate opened, so they could rest for a few minutes.
They figure, why not note down a few flame arts while at it?
Then, finally, there are those who wanted to read through and hope to find something they could use to climb further.
These were the people Kent was interested in.
They were called the survivalists.
They knew how and when to adapt.
They knew when to look for ways to keep moving.

Giving up was not in their books because, unlike those who saw their limits as obstacles or those who wanted contingency plans, this group of people wanted to keep moving, but they lacked the strength; they still had their conviction.

They wanted to reach the top, and to do that, they knew their current strength wouldn’t take them far. So, they were adapting, aiming to utilize the weaker techniques to boost their chances of reaching their desired destination.
If anyone were worthy of earning his respect, then Kent would surely give it to them.
He spotted seven people who were looking through Body Enhancement Flame Arts.
’Tower, do your thing. Find them good techniques, and I will handle the rest.’
[Core of the Universe – Lady Universe’s POV]
She watched as Kent analyzed everyone climbing the stairway, and for a moment, a sense of pride appeared in her eyes when he saw Kent note down the seven people.

"Sometimes I forget how he sees these people. They are not the best or the brightest. They are not the ones packed with so much talent. They are not the ones that will stand above all. They are not the ones that will blaze on the battlefield," She smiled.

"They are the kind who would never give up. The ones that will always survive. The ones who, against all odds, will find a way to prevail. They never use underhanded means; they rely on their own intelligence to live.
They also survive for that is their belief, always to survive."
A tear fell from her eyes as she recalled a moment that happened billions of years ago. And now, as she watched Kent pay attention to these people, a sense of déjà vu overwhelmed her.
The unknown legends speak of the day the past and the future aligned.
That day, the Undead, led by the Unyielding Kaizo, appeared.
The Soul Sentinels, led by the Astra Soul Warden, also appeared.
The Eternal Wrath, led by the Towering Flame Tyrant Aetheris, also appeared.
The 14 Lost knights, led by the Void Monarch Veydris, also appeared.
But they weren’t the only ones.
That day, Krex Nithal, the undying cockroach, also led his legion of survivalists, joining the Great War of the primordial Era.

chapters.title: Chapter 766: The survivalists [Bonus]
paragraphs: ⟦I have analysed all the Flame Arts on the first level. There are 102 of them. Seventy-two are Attack-type Flame Arts, 20 are Defense-type Flame Arts, and ten are Enhance-type Flame Arts.⟧
⟦If the master wants these techniques, replicating them will cost just 1 million tower points.⟧

"Go ahead. I don’t need them, but I am sure I will be able to learn something from them," Kent smiled as he stepped on the 100th step. The moment he did, he felt all forms of heat vanish from his surroundings.
Some people noticed him, but with them busily looking for a technique to learn or those already learning, talking was no luxury they could afford.
The Half-Elves had long passed the first level, so he had no reason to talk to anyone. The only ones he wanted to talk to were the seven he picked from the dozens on the first floor.
The tower took one million tower points and copied the techniques as if they were nothing.
Of course, the tower is overpowered to an extent that surpasses anyone’s understanding. It can do many things if Kent wants.

The only things it can’t do are go against laws that cannot be broken without consequences. If anything, something as simple as this Flame Tower isn’t a match for the overpowered Tower inside Kent’s soul.
The Flame Tower is just an Immortal-grade item. It is powerful, perhaps even powerful if it were in a High World. However, when measured against Kent’s tower, the gap is just too vast.
So he copied the skills and would use them later because he wasn’t just copying them for nothing.
Kent walked toward a Tigerkin and tapped him on the shoulder. "Follow me if you want to have a shot at reaching the third level and mastering a technique."

With that, Kent moved toward a beautiful Qilin lady and said the same thing to her before moving to a Dwarf. Afterwards, he moved to a Flame Demon and a Dark Elf. The last two were an Ice Demon and a Shadow Demon.
It wasn’t the lineup one would pay attention to, but Kent saw something in them and, in his own way, planned to help them. In the future, they will pay him back several times over.
After tapping the seven, Kent moved to the side and let them take their time to come. Two minutes later, they stood before him.

The others who saw this strange behavior could only wonder silently in their heads. They had no idea what Kent was doing, but they knew it was none of their business, so their focus was on their own affairs.
Kent studied their faces and sighed.
"I will make this short so you can get back to your business. Don’t ask me how I know, but I know that you seven are looking for the best enhancement Flame Art that can aid you in climbing further.
First of all, don’t be ashamed of seeking help. Be proud, for you are survivalists, someone who knows how to survive at all costs.
That said, I have a way to help you seven. All I ask is to reach the 3rd floor, which, if you don’t slack, you can make it within one day, or one and a half if your determination isn’t strong enough.

Now, my help isn’t for free. Of course, I am not asking you to become my slaves. I hate slavery, so wipe that out of your head. However, I do want something from you, and that is to see you survive the next 3 years.
If you manage to survive and grow much stronger over the next 3 years, I will tell you what I want in return for helping you today.
And for what I have to offer, I will help you climb and have a shot at comprehending at least two Mystical-grade Flame Arts on the third floor.
This means I will help you now, and you will pay me back three years from today. Are you in?"
It took a moment, but the seven nodded, bringing a smile to Kent’s lips as he took out three fruits: Immortal Grade Ambrosia Apple, 10,000-year-old Spirit Grapefruit, and Lotus Plum Mind Fruit.
He handed them to all seven of them. "Eat the grape first, apple second, and lotus last. Afterward, you can proceed to learn these techniques...
Also, please do not mention the three items I gave you to your leaders. If they ask, tell them I helped you, but you cannot say what the help was.
I know you’re smart, so you’ll figure something out.
If you try anything funny, don’t say I didn’t warn you."
Kent went ahead and told them the names of the techniques he picked for them based on their profiles.
"Until then, see you all later." With that, Kent left and headed to the second level, leaving the seven stunned youngsters behind.
It was only after Kent left the first floor that they breathed. They looked at each other for a moment before Lorin, the lady Qilin, placed the grape in her mouth and ate it.
The others followed her, and soon, all seven of them were in the lotus posture, absorbing the energy they felt entering their bodies.
Meanwhile, on the outside, all names had been displayed on the board. However, some names stood out.
At the top was Freya Stoneforge, the youngest princess of the Dwarves. Her appearance at the top was normal, for she is known as the best flame user in the younger generation.
Following her was Helga Forog, best friend of Freya and the second-best flame user in this year’s selection to enter the power.

Prince Roran Fireclaw, the second prince of the Flame Dragons, took the third spot. He is also an impressive young person, someone everyone knows and recognises. He has a remarkable journey ahead of him.
An Elf took the fourth spot, and the fifth was also an Elf. Then, from the 7th onwards, there was a mix of other races. The 26th to the 33rd were all half-elves.
Kent was still below the 50th percentile because he had delayed his climb. But now that he had found the ones he wanted, his journey had only begun.

"It’s been only an hour, but a few have already reached the 2nd Level. It seems this year, we might actually be seeing some impressive talents," Elder Lance said, tracking Kent’s name as he moved slowly through the ranks.

There are 102 of them.
Seventy-two are Attack-type Flame Arts, 20 are Defense-type Flame Arts, and ten are Enhance-type Flame Arts.⟧
⟦If the master wants these techniques, replicating them will cost just 1 million tower points.⟧
"Go ahead.
I don’t need them, but I am sure I will be able to learn something from them," Kent smiled as he stepped on the 100th step.
The moment he did, he felt all forms of heat vanish from his surroundings.
Some people noticed him, but with them busily looking for a technique to learn or those already learning, talking was no luxury they could afford.
The Half-Elves had long passed the first level, so he had no reason to talk to anyone.
The only ones he wanted to talk to were the seven he picked from the dozens on the first floor.
The tower took one million tower points and copied the techniques as if they were nothing.
Of course, the tower is overpowered to an extent that surpasses anyone’s understanding.
It can do many things if Kent wants.
The only things it can’t do are go against laws that cannot be broken without consequences.
If anything, something as simple as this Flame Tower isn’t a match for the overpowered Tower inside Kent’s soul.
The Flame Tower is just an Immortal-grade item.
It is powerful, perhaps even powerful if it were in a High World.
However, when measured against Kent’s tower, the gap is just too vast.
So he copied the skills and would use them later because he wasn’t just copying them for nothing.
Kent walked toward a Tigerkin and tapped him on the shoulder.
"Follow me if you want to have a shot at reaching the third level and mastering a technique."
With that, Kent moved toward a beautiful Qilin lady and said the same thing to her before moving to a Dwarf.
Afterwards, he moved to a Flame Demon and a Dark Elf.
The last two were an Ice Demon and a Shadow Demon.
It wasn’t the lineup one would pay attention to, but Kent saw something in them and, in his own way, planned to help them.
In the future, they will pay him back several times over.
After tapping the seven, Kent moved to the side and let them take their time to come.
Two minutes later, they stood before him.
The others who saw this strange behavior could only wonder silently in their heads.
They had no idea what Kent was doing, but they knew it was none of their business, so their focus was on their own affairs.

Be proud, for you are survivalists, someone who knows how to survive at all costs.
That said, I have a way to help you seven.
All I ask is to reach the 3rd floor, which, if you don’t slack, you can make it within one day, or one and a half if your determination isn’t strong enough.
Now, my help isn’t for free.
Of course, I am not asking you to become my slaves.
I hate slavery, so wipe that out of your head.
However, I do want something from you, and that is to see you survive the next 3 years.
If you manage to survive and grow much stronger over the next 3 years, I will tell you what I want in return for helping you today.
And for what I have to offer, I will help you climb and have a shot at comprehending at least two Mystical-grade Flame Arts on the third floor.
This means I will help you now, and you will pay me back three years from today.

chapters.title: Chapter 767: Fast Climber [Bonus]
paragraphs: It took Kent five minutes to reach the second level.
The steps leading to the 2nd level were much more challenging to climb, considering the air there was comparable to the core region of the Flame Valley.
Kent had already been there, so it was easy for him to gauge that.

However, with his ’Flame Resistance,’ ’Diamond Body Cultivation,’ ’Eternal Draconic Jade Body,’ and finally, his ’Chaos Soul Flame’ at work, he walked upward like he was taking a stroll across the countryside.
On the way, he passed by a few dozen geniuses doing everything they could to climb to the second floor.

He saw a few who he knew wouldn’t be able to make it and would have to go back to the first floor. He passed by a few who could make it, but whose chances of learning a Flame Art would be slim, and then those who knew what they were doing and would gain something from it.
None of these people moved Kent’s heart, so he walked by them as if they were nothing. When he saw those he knew would benefit him, he knew.
So, without glancing at anyone, he arrived on the second level, where he saw quite a few already seated, learning the techniques they had chosen.
’Legendary grade is not bad, and like the Elder said, as one’s mastery of their Flame increases, so would the output of the techniques regardless of their grade.
It’s just like sword aura and intent. The stronger the energy, the more powerful the skill used becomes.’ Kent noted that down and chose to move on.
He can get a legendary grade technique for as low as 300,000 tower points, so they were useless to him now. However, he paid the tower 5 million tower points to copy all 70 techniques.
They will have their use later. For now, he could only move on.
Kent left the second level and started moving toward the 3rd level.
After climbing three steps, three messages appeared before his eyes.
⟦You have absorbed a large sum of Flame Essence.⟧
⟦Your Flame Resistance grows stronger.⟧
⟦Your Chaos Soul Flame grows stronger.⟧
"Looks like the real deal starts from here." Kent smiled, and then, without even doing anything, the tower activated his cultivation technique.
⟦Your Primordial Infinity Dragon Art has activated. Your cultivation speed is now 40,000 times faster.⟧
Kent smiled, reading the new message. He had even forgotten about his cultivation technique, as he had to dual-cultivate with his wives to grow stringer instead of cultivating like everyone else.
However, now that it had activated, Kent saw how impressive it was. It turned out he was much more amazing than he let on, and that was evident when the technique activated.
All the heat on the steps vanished.

To Kent, the steps leading to the 3rd level were just normal steps, since all that was meant to block him was absorbed, or more accurately, devoured, sharing everything equally among his Body Cultivation, Soul Flame, Flame Resistance, and his True Cultivation, which began to soar.
"It was 4,000 times when I got this world. But now that I have awakened 16% of my bloodline, the speed has increased."
Kent kept moving, knowing full well that this was all thanks to the tower, which, after all, he had created in his past life.
"I guess I am just that impressive," he laughed, moving past the first person also climbing to the third floor.
Kent moved forward for a while and then stopped and turned back to the Elf he had just passed.
’With the tower’s protection, I can kill this dude and get away with it, but that would be a waste. Looking at his determination, he has some potential in him.’
He looked at him for a few seconds and then took a spirit grapefruit from his space ring and threw it to him.
"When you reach your limit and can’t go any further, eat that. Of course, don’t try climbing to the 4th floor since you don’t have the means."
With that, Kent left, leaving the elf to contemplate whether or not to eat. After a few internal struggles, he stored the fruit inside his space ring and kept climbing.
He would hold on to that for now until his limit wouldn’t allow him to climb any further.
⟦Why did you help him master⟧? Just when he was a few steps away from the Elf, the tower asked. Kent just smiled.
’He looks like an actor I worked with back on Earth. Although he was human, if we put a prosthetic ear on him, the two would be practically twins.’
If the tower were human, she would have probably laughed.

Kent was messing with the tower, but a part of what he said was genuine. Though his main reason for helping the Elves was so that if one day, the Elves and the Half-Elves found peace, he would make him a Guardian Hand.
Until then, that was all the help he could render, and he did the same for all those he passed by on his way to the 3rd floor.
They will thank him later, and if in three years they manage to meet his expectations, he will take them to a much bigger pool where they can grow endlessly.
When Kent arrived on the 3rd level, he saw a few others deep in their learning processes.
These ones were the geniuses the Supreme Immortal sect was truly looking for. They were the geniuses who could further strengthen the sect.
After ensuring his friends weren’t there and copying all the techniques, he began moving to the 4th level. His strength continued to rise as he climbed.
Meanwhile, after three hours, the seven youngsters Kent had helped on the first level each completed absorbing the fruits he had given them, and they began the techniques he had told them to master.
They felt stronger, smarter, and, more importantly, determined.
However, nothing prepared them for what happened when they entered the technique space to learn their techniques.

The first person was able to master all five forms of the technique in just 10 minutes. When Lorin, the beautiful Qilin lady, opened her eyes, she felt as though she could fly through the steps leading to the second level.
And she wasn’t the only one; the others felt the same way when they opened their eyes in less than 15 minutes.
On the outside, the display board showed the results of what was happening inside the tower for all to see, and for the first time, everyone swallowed nervously.

chapters.title: Chapter 768: Breaking the Ranking
paragraphs: Elder Lance asked, staring dumbfoundedly at the display board.
The two disciples beside him wore the same expression.
On the board display, it showed that Lorin Talyth was the top ranker among the hundreds who entered the Flame Tower.
Of course, that could be managed, considering that when it comes to the tower, merely being the strongest doesn’t mean they would be the top rankers..
The tower looks at flame resistance and understanding. So perhaps she has the talent and has hidden it from everyone. That can be assumed and perhaps speculated.
However, what appeared before her name, now ranked at the top, was what shocked everyone. Of course, they were even more blown away when the first seven names appeared.
> > > FLAME TOWER PARTICIPANT RANKING CHART<<<
1. Lorin Talyth - Flame Art (1) - Grade (Heaven) - Mastered Forms (5/5) - Level (1)
2. Helmir Stonehand - Flame Art (1) - Grade (Heaven) - Mastered Forms (5/5) - Level (1)
3. Daryon Kyran - Flame Art (1) - Grade (Heaven) - Mastered Forms (5/5) - Level (1)
4. Vaelis Thorncrest – Flame Art (1) – Grade (Heaven) – Mastered Forms (5/5) – Level (1)
5. Serika Dawnflare – Flame Art (1) – Grade (Heaven) – Mastered Forms (5/5) – Level (1)
6. Kaelen Virel – Flame Art (1) – Grade (Heaven) – Mastered Forms (5/5) – Level (1)
7. Thalara Cindervine – Flame Art (1) – Grade (Heaven) – Mastered Forms (5/5) – Level (1)
All seven names were of people nobody expected to take the top seven spots. And to think they all mastered a heavenly grade technique completely — that is just too much.

"Just what is happening to this year’s Flame Tower trial? Not only have seven people mastered a technique, but they have also mastered all five forms of it, and this accomplishment was achieved in under four hours.
That is just too much," Elder Lance said, looking at the display board with a shocked expression.
Lord Qilin looked at the board with a puzzled expression.

"Elder Vaelrith, which sect is the Lorin girl from again?" Though he is the leader of the Qilin and the entirety of the Beast Race, he doesn’t know everyone, and he most certainly didn’t know much about Lorin, considering he only came out of seclusion a few hours ago to attend this event.
But now, seeing someone from his race dominating the charts, he couldn’t help but ask.

Elder Vaelrith leaned in and answered, "She is the daughter of a 5th in command of the Qilin army and the top third ranker in the Dawnless Sect. We initially estimated she would only be able to reach the second level and perhaps master a technique.
But we never expected her to show promising results from the get-go."
The elder was both shocked and happy. The fact that someone from his race was this impressive made all the difference here.
But they weren’t the only ones wondering just what had happened. The Flame Demons, the Tigerkin, the Dwarves, the Dark Elves, the Ice and Shadow Demons — all of them were wondering the same thing.

The names that appeared on their board aren’t from people of high standing. In the seven races, all seven of them were merely added to the roster because, while there are millions in these races, finding talented flame users is rare.
But now, something this unexpected had happened, and everyone couldn’t wrap their heads around it.
They just don’t understand what was going on.
Of course, while everyone was wondering what the hell was happening, the half-elves were just sighing in their hearts, knowing full well who was behind the current events inside the Flame Tower.
They already knew this had something to do with Kent, for he was the only one with the means to make nobodies suddenly gain recognition and strength like the seven names now displayed on the board.
’Just what is your angle here, Kent?’ Queen Jascia wondered, not understanding what Kent intended to gain by making seven nobodies suddenly gain prominence.
Meanwhile, back inside the tower, the seven who mastered their Flame Arts stood on the path leading to the second level.
"Are you all ready?" Lorin asked, and all six with her nodded in agreement.
"Then let’s go." Thus, they moved and soon started climbing to the second level.

On the outside, the seven races may not be united. But inside the tower, a friendship was formed, one that saw seven unlikely people become friends, born out of sheer determination to compete with those born into privilege.
Kent was already on his way to the fourth level, unaware that his generosity had created seven grateful survivalists, all focused on proving their worth.

"The heat from here is rather potent," Kent said as he moved from one step to the next. Although his cultivation technique was working, he could still feel the heat, indicating just how much energy they were exerting against each other.

After climbing the 35th step, he caught up to the first of the few brave ones climbing to the fourth level. It was a lady elf. When Kent got to her side and saw how she was struggling, he knew she wouldn’t make it.
She had the determination, but deep within her eyes, she knew she wouldn’t be able to make it.
"You know, sometimes it is okay to give up," Kent said, taking the next step upward, making sure he was facing the lady.
"We were often taught how to keep moving and never give up. However, in some situations, you just have to know that giving up is the only answer.
So why not just give up? Learning mystical-grade flame arts isn’t too bad. You can become famous with just a single mystical-grade flame art, especially in a medium world like Sonox.
So just give up and go learn one. At least with 2 days and 17 hours still left, you can master two mystical-grade techniques."
The smile on his face would infuriate everyone, especially someone like a prideful elf, who was meant to be boiling like hot water.
But to Kent’s surprise, she ignored him and took the next step, slowly stood up straight, and looked at him.
"Maybe you humans give up because you are losers, but on this side of the world, we elves don’t give up... never."
Kent smiled, hearing her answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 769: Determined.
paragraphs: Kent wasn’t offended by being called a loser.
If anything, he was amused looking at the struggling Elf who he knew deep within his heart wouldn’t make it to the 4th level.
The path leading there is much more torturous.
If Kent were to guess, she would lose determination on the 60th step, for that is where he could see his friends.
"Have you ever heard of blind determination?" Kent asked, sitting on the step, legs crossed and left hand supporting his chin.
"Blind determination is when you want to prove yourself to someone as a form of pleasing them. You fight so hard just so you could show everyone you are worthy to be among the privileged.
You, Kella, aren’t meant to be among such people.
You are not privileged like the overly pampered elves you are chasing after. They had a silver spoon stuck in their mouth from the day they were born.
You had to fight for it. You worked hard to build your strength and managed to get into the lineup because your people took ten slots from the half-elves.

However, you are here now, and while you think learning a Mythic grade technique will make you a royalty like them, know that at the core, you are just Kella, daughter of an Artisan who happened to awaken her soul flame, and is naturally gifted to wield the flame.
Don’t chase after them. Don’t walk with blind determination.
Instead of thinking of pleasing the Elf Queen, think of pleasing yourself.
You are not inferior to anyone, not when you possess talent like yours. So instead of looking to become one of those greenhouse flowers, surpass them instead.
For if you continue to chase after them, you will falter, and the result will be devastating for you." Kent stood up and looked ahead, seeing the backs of Cyran and Helyra.
’Looks like they took the Pill and would soon awaken an innate talent.’ He smiled and turned back to Kella.
"If you truly want to get to the 4th level, then start climbing for yourself and not the Elf Queen. That said, I like talented people, so I will give you this.
You have 2 days and 17 hours-ish before the tower closes. This means you still have time. However, if you continue down this path, you will be wasting time.
But if you manage to reach the 4th level, take this fruit. It will help you in the mastery of at least two Mythic grade techniques.
I can help you easily climb, but I won’t. So use your determination as your strength, and the reward will be yours. Remember, fighting to please someone is not the way.
Of course, if you can change your determination, the fight to please your father. That is much better than aiming to become a royalty."
With that, Kent walked away, leaving the Lotus Plum mind Fruit with Kella.
The Elven girl looked at the fruit for three whole minutes before storing it away. She had a lot of thinking to do and a short time to do it.
She had no idea how Kent managed to read her thoughts and know what she was chasing after. She was indeed trying to be recognised by the Elven Queen, for she wanted to live a life of affluence.

Perhaps she wanted to appear regal like her mates. So she worked for it. However, what nobody, not even the Elf Queen, knew was that, unlike most of the Elves who had inherited their soul flames from Flame Beasts, Kella awakened her own manually.
He father made sure she covered that up, for he knew if it were recognized, she would be taken from him and made into a doll that the Elves would use to boost their power.
They will use her name to boast, and that is not something he wanted for his daughter.
So she remained low-key and hoped one day, when the elven queen recognized her, she would show this amazing side of herself.
"He even knows my secret. Just who is this kid?"
She sat down and started to come to terms with herself.
Meanwhile, Kent had already reached Cyran and Helyra, who are seated in the lotus posture, absorbing the essence of the pill they’ve taken.
Kent didn’t want to disturb them, so after dropping a pouch before them, he moved ahead.

On the 64th step, Arion, Doreen, and Elia were also there. He left the care package with them and moved ahead. On the 67th step, he caught up to others: one Dwarf, one Flame demon, two Flame Dragons, and an Elf.
Kent moved past them, knowing full well they would be able to make it to the 4th floor.
On the way, he passed by another Elf, then he caught up to the last three members of his group on the 85th step. He left the care package with them and moved ahead.

On the 90th step, he caught up to another Elf, then on the 92nd step, he caught up to a flame Dragon, and on the 97th step, he finally caught up to Freya Stoneforge, the genius among the flame users in the current generation.
"More grease to your elbow, little one," Kent said with a smile as he tossed a pouch containing two lotus plums.
"You are smart, so you will know what to do once you eat one." With that, Kent moved ahead and soon appeared on the 4th level, where 36 tomes were held aloft, each a Mythic-grade technique.
Kent walked through and examined the names of the techniques. He knew he shouldn’t underestimate the grades of techniques, and he was right; the techniques are no simple ones.
"I mean, these are mythic grade techniques. I would be an idiot if I didn’t take them." Kent grinned, an evil expression plastering his face.
He paid the tower 12 million tower points, and like with the first three levels, it copied the techniques.

Kent was satisfied with his gain because he knew this was a good harvest. One Mythic-grade technique will cost several hundred million spirit stones, so paying 12 million tower points for 36 of them is already more than sufficient.
"Now, I need to get to the 5th level where nobody has ever been."
He looked toward the fifth level and smiled.
"Entering the sect with Divine grade techniques, huh. I wonder what the others will think when I come rolling in with divine grade techniques."
With a blissful smile, Kent started ascending the stairway leading to the 5th level.

chapters.title: Chapter 770: Weak Flame Comprehension
paragraphs: The moment Kent stepped on the first step leading to the fifth level, he felt a change in the air. It was instant, like how it was meant to be.
Initially, it was just hot.
There was nothing else to it.
It was pure heat, one that made those with no real talent for flame control and circulation give up easily. It was merely a battle against the heat, and Kent won due to his overpowering aspects.
However, now, it was more than just heat.
This time, there was intent behind the heat.
It felt heavy, challenging, and validating.
The feeling was just too bland, like whoever designed the Flame Tower wasn’t really sure anyone would dare to brave the fifth level, so they just left their intent there without much refinement.

But while that may be an oversight on their part, Kent was now facing the music, and while he would love to say this time he could breeze through easily, the truth of the matter was that he had to take it slower this time.
And he did. He started moving slowly, allowing his body to adapt and benefit from the heat energy.
After ascending the 30th step, Kent felt something within his body activate, causing a smile to spread across his face.
His Flame Art, which he spent millions on, was finally activated, increasing his understanding of the flame merely by climbing the stairs.
"I guess I was right all along. If the heat is just too much, the technique will automatically kick in thanks to my Sword Mind passive skill."
With that activated, Kent increased his pace some more, though he wasn’t walking through the process like somebody who had already adapted to the Flame Tower.
⟦Your understanding of the flame has increased, slightly⟧
⟦Your weak flame resistance grows stronger⟧
⟦Your soul flame grows stronger⟧
These three messages started showing every step he climbed. Naturally, this was something everyone would love to have, and Kent was having it.
He had already surpassed the level where he would have to sit down and cultivate like the others were doing, so he was merely moving through the process like it was the most normal thing to do.
Meanwhile, on the fourth level, Freya Stoneforge had just managed to step onto the last step, feeling the heat wash away from her body.
She took a big exhale and then looked around her.
"Huh... where is that human?" she wondered, not seeing Kent around. She expected to see him and confront him for calling her a little one. But as it turns out, Kent was nowhere to be found.
"Was I hallucinating?" she wondered, not seeing anyone around. Of course, the moment her eyes landed on the punch in her hand, she knew she wasn’t hallucinating.
Kent gave her that pouch, so he was supposed to find it at the 4th level.
Then the realization struck her.
"He is heading to the fifth floor." Just saying this was enough to make her choke on her breath, feeling her body shake in fear.

The road to the fourth level was no simple thing. She had already been through it, and while she would love to one day brag about her accomplishment, she knew that it wouldn’t be pleasant whenever she remembered how much she had to endure just to get to the fourth level.
However, to think somebody had actually started climbing to the fifth level...
"This is just too much. Just what is he made of?" She thought for a second, then shook her head.

"I can’t let a mere human shake my heart." With that thought, she opened the pouch, which Kent had left her, and found two fruits in it. Initially, she didn’t know what was in the pouch, but now that she could smell the fruit, she knew it was no ordinary fruit.
Just smelling it was already showing its effect.
So she decided to eat it and see what it could do. If it turned out well, she would be happy; otherwise, she would get down to business and do what she was there for.
However, when the fruit melted in her mouth, she felt her mind expand, encompassing more than she could have thought possible.
Suddenly, she felt like the most intelligent person in the room.
"This is..." Her mind, despite being opened and strengthened, couldn’t come up with words to describe what had just happened.
The Lotus Plum Mind Fruit is one of the basic fruits one can use to strengthen one’s mind. Eating just one will expand brain space, increase thinking capacity, and, most importantly, enhance it.

It is not enough to start Mind cultivation, but it is enough to increase one’s comprehension abilities to the point that something they would need to spend a year learning can be done in an hour or perhaps a week, depending on one’s initial comprehension speed.
Freya Stoneforge is already a genius, so the moment she ate the Lotus Plum Mind Fruit, her comprehension speed increased tremendously.

"Just who is that human?" With her mind opened, she started to wonder about Kent yet again. However, after a few minutes of wondering the same thing - Kent’s identity - she decided to focus on what she came to the 4th level to do.
"Hurry up, Helga. With this fruit, we can finally change our destiny and prove to everyone that Dwarves are not simple."
With that, she moved toward the 36 tomes and began looking through them to find the techniques she wanted and those she would recommend to her friend once she reached the fourth level.
⟦Your understanding of the flame has increased greatly⟧
⟦Your weak flame resistance grows stronger⟧
⟦Your soul flame grows stronger⟧

Kent stepped on the 67th step, and like he had expected, a new set of messages appeared. Only this time, instead of his understanding increasing slightly, it moved to the next stage, which was greatly.
"Almost there at this point," Kent said as he stepped on the 68th step, feeling the heat increase yet again. The intent had also intensified, pressing down hard on him.
He took the step to the 69th step, and that was when a different message appeared.
⟦Your understanding of the flame has increased tremendously⟧
⟦Congratulations, you have attained weak flame comprehension⟧
"Finally," Kent smiled, feeling something unlock within him. It was foreign, almost like it wasn’t meant to be there in the first place. But Kent felt it, and that was when he knew he had done it.
He felt his understanding of the flame expand toward a path he never knew possible.
"Damn, at this rate, complete extraction can be mastered since I never knew I could handle the flame this way," Kent said, smiling.
His main reason for learning the flame was for alchemy, and now that he had attained some level of comprehension, he started to see a path forward.
A crazy path, one where his control over the flame will reach Perfect Harmony, making him gain the flame recognition and finally become one with the flame.
Of course, another motivation was his duel with the pill princess.
"I don’t know her, but judging by how everyone talks about her, I have no doubt she has already mastered complete extraction. I also need to accomplish that and perhaps even go for dual concoction."

Kent knew he was perhaps just expecting a good duel, which was why he was being paranoid. But it wouldn’t hurt to gain some understanding of the flame and increase his skills in alchemy before entering the sect.
"Onward then." With his understanding already at the weak stage, Kent knew it was only a matter of time before he got to the fifth level.
So he started climbing yet again.
