chapters.title: Chapter 780: Flame Lord Mission [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Thank you, Kent. Had it not been for you, we wouldn’t have made it even to the 3rd level," Norion said the moment they stepped out of the portal.
Kent smiled and shook his head. "I merely provided the tools; you did all the work, so you should be proud of yourselves."
"Even so, you’ve changed our lives, and for that, we will forever be grateful," Princess Elowen said with a bow, and the seven others followed.
The hall became calm, filled with happiness, as all eight half-elves looked at the human who had made their dreams come true and even added some additional perks to it.

Not only had they reached the 5th level of the flame tower, somewhere nobody had ever gotten, but they also managed to learn a divine-grade technique—something that can take them as far as an Immortal world, and, in their case, will continue to increase in strength as their soul flames grow stronger.
Aside from that, he even helped them awaken their Flame Bodies.
What he had done for them was akin to changing the fate of an entire race; only this time, he had done it by turning eight half-elves into powerhouses.

They were grateful, and if Kent were to be a god, he would have felt their fate in his strengthening. Of course, he could see it for the soul essence he was receiving from the Half-Elves had just increased by 3.
He smiled, feeling like an accomplished con artist.
Of course, this time, he hadn’t scammed anyone, but had worked for it.
"The next few days should be about you eight training like your lives depended on it. The endgame is to rise above all else and surpass everyone who stands in your path.
Use the next few days to get accustomed to your Flame Bodies and focus on three key techniques. If you can’t, focus on two, but prioritize defense and enhancement.
I have a feeling you eight are going to be famous in the sect."
They nodded and walked away to attend to their tasks. Uncle Drake walked into the hall a few seconds later and sat beside Kent.
"They’ve even surpassed expectations. Not only did they manage to learn seven mythic-grade techniques, but they also learned a divine-grade technique.
This time, my race will also soar above all else," King Thalirion said with a cheerful smile. The elders and Queen Jascia wore the same smile.
"They indeed surprise even me. However, this also shows that they have potential that will take them even further. For now, they must join the sect.
That said, I believe they have what it takes to get in, so we shouldn’t be worried. Also, I think with the path they’ve taken, their growth will only continue to soar."
Kent turned to Uncle Drake. "You must help them in the next few days. You are the best person to help them when it comes to using the flame."
"I will do my best." Uncle Drake was already looking forward to this assignment, for he could tell something had changed about them.
They looked and felt more confident, and for that, he wanted to see what he could do to bring out more of their potential.
"I will be gone for the next six days, so I might even miss the auction. But don’t worry, Uncle Drake is here for any trouble.
Additionally, be prepared to start receiving visitors soon. I know you can handle them, for you already have your own thing going on."
The Half-Elves laughed, and Kent stood up.

Now that he saw a way forward in the path of flame cultivation, he wanted to work on that. But first, he must visit the ladies currently preparing to enter the third floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon.
A few seconds later, he left...
[100 Immortal and 99 Divine World Star System – Divine World Naia – The Devil’s Flame Peak]
Planet Naia is one of the 99 Divine worlds in the 100 Immortal and 99 Divine World Star System. In the realm of immortal worlds, this star system is one of the strongest.
It contains 100 immortal worlds and 99 Divine worlds. Planet Naia is one of the divine worlds that, by understanding, is capable of housing both immortals and gods.
It is much larger, perhaps 10,000 times larger than Sonox. And just like Sonox, it is a mixed-race planet, meaning it has humans, Elves, Orcs, Dragons, and the like.
However, away from all that, it also has some of the most dangerous places in the universe.
One such place is the Devil’s Flame Peak. It is a mountain made of flames and magma. Its terror is unlike any other.
Those below the True Immortal stage dare not set foot even thousands of miles from it. Even Lord Immortals go there at their peril.

Perhaps only demi-gods and gods dare go there. But even gods with no good grasp of the flame dare not get cocky and try to traverse the vast and colossal mountain said to share a boundary with the first Layer of Hell.

However, while many dare not venture there, some with balls large enough have gone. Of course, some never return; however, Agni Sauron, the Flame Lord, has been in seclusion there for the past 24 thousand years.
He went there after he finally managed to hide the first form of the [Finger of Destruction] Technique. Over the past 24,000 years, he has been cultivating his flame resistance and comprehension.
However, just a few minutes ago, someone who had his eyes closed for the past 24 years finally opened them.
That simple gesture caused the Devil’s Flame Peak to shudder, causing a monster stampede that the Flame Orcs bordering the location where he was secluded would have to take care of.
"Hahahahaha..." Agni, on the other hand, didn’t care about the fact that he had unleashed hordes of immortal stage beasts on the orcs.
His laughter rang out for many minutes before calming down.

"The Primordial Chaos Dragon has finally awakened, and the first person to know is me." His smile bloomed. "I will meet you soon, my lord. This humble servant will soon meet you and become a vessel you can command."
His fist slammed his chest three times like a warrior swearing his allegiance.
Suddenly, the space around him cracked, and a scroll fell. Agni caught it with a surprised look and immediately unfurled it.
The moment his eyes landed on the content of the scroll, a shocked look appeared on his face...

⟦You have been recognized by the Last of the True Primordials – The Primordial Chaos Dragon. To show your dedication and commitment to serving him, you are hereby commanded to cross the boundary and retrieve the Hell Flame Scroll and deliver it to the High Priestess of Mekyn (High World).
You have three years to complete it. Failure is not an option.
After the mission is done, your rewards will be delivered with added perks. Good luck.⟧
Agni looked at the scroll disintegrating in his hands, a smile blossoming on his face. He stood up and walked for a few seconds before standing at the entrance of the cave he was in.
"I guess it is time to get chased down to hell." His laughter echoed in the mountains as he vanished into thin air.

chapters.title: Chapter 781: The Eight Terrifying Undead
paragraphs: "Kent..."
The moment Kent appeared inside the second floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon, he was surrounded by fairies, each coming for a kiss. It’s been a while since they last saw him.
He kissed all his women, making sure they felt his warmth.
"How are you all doing?"
"We are just getting ready to head to the third floor. Will you be joining us?" Unity said, sounding rather happy now that Kent had arrived.
"Looking at how much you all have grown, I don’t think you need me to help you clear the third floor, but since I am here, I might as well go with you to see what is there."
They all nodded, feeling even more secure. Kent’s presence felt calming enough that they wouldn’t mind him staying for a while.
Though they knew he was a busy person, asking him to stay was not an option.
"But before we head to the third floor, I have some things to handle first." Kent snapped his fingers, and eight portals appeared.
Eight terrifying undead walked out, bringing with them a powerful pressure that everyone felt; even Kent felt his body getting pressed down.
This shows his new undead aren’t simple at all.
Before entering seclusion, he gave the task of creating eight undead using the Undead Schematic he had received from the many quests he had completed to Gaia and her two sisters.
Naturally, Kent expected and knew the three troublemakers would handle the job well or even beyond his imagination.
They did a remarkable job, one that made him wonder just what ran through their minds. They designed the undead and added the personalities that will make them both relatable and equally fierce.

However, what he didn’t expect was that six of the eight undead would be ladies. That part took him aback. However, while that part of the outcome was unexpected, the eight undead were anything but simple.
Somehow, in a funny yet surprising kind of way, the three cosmic lolis used the shadows and the void to create some of the most powerful beings Kent had yet to see their kind in this life.
They were supposed to be created months ago, but they were stuck in a loop or some weird comatose state.
The reason they were stuck in that loop was so that Kent could awaken their true names. Now he did, and they are ready to fight for him.

The first one that appeared was somehow different from the eight that had just appeared and less terrifying than them. However, she was, in fact, the strongest among them and is now the strongest in the legion.
Not even Kent’s wives could compare to her.
Even if their primordial spirits joined in, perhaps someone like Unity or Princess Lovina would have a shot at defeating her.
But even so, their chances are slim.
She is clad in elegant violet mage armor, reinforced with arcane weave and dark mythril threads, her silvery-white hair cascading down her back.

Her amethyst eyes glow faintly, almost similar to Kent’s own purple eyes, and in her hand is a long, elegant staff that can be converted into twin swords, allowing her to go into melee when she wants to or is tired of being a mage.
Her name is Elyndra, a Voidweaver Sorceress.
The reason she is dangerous is that she specializes in spatial manipulation, arcane destruction, and soul-binding illusions.
Perhaps Veera, who until Elyndra appeared held the title of strongest in the legion, can fight her to some extent.
Still, with Elyndra’s understanding of spatial magic, Veera cannot compete with her current comprehension of the void.
The gap between them is vast, and that alone will go against Veera.
The second is also a lady, clad in black-laced exoskeletal armor interwoven with pulsing crimson tendrils. Blood-petal mist swirls around her body, hiding her form in a haze of shadow and crimson.
Of course, this is just her warrior look. If she were to deactivate it, she would be approachable. But in her battle-ready state, she seems both elegant and terrifying.
That is Morne, the Moonveil Executioner. Her class is rare, combining lunar sorcery, deathbinding arts, and cursed blade mastery.
Almost everything about her is somehow related to death.
The third is also a lady.
She is clad in jet-black Gothic armor with intricate, bone-etched engravings and glowing, red veins that pulse faintly.
Her cloak is torn, but it flows like a shadow itself, red on the inside, black on the outside.
Her hood covers most of her face, revealing only a faint crimson glow beneath.
Just like Morne, Velmora also has a rare class called Reaper Empress.
It is a class that makes her a supreme executioner of shadows.
She commands souls and dances with death itself.
She is a master of scythes, shadows, and forbidden death arts.
Kent planned to talk to his three assistants about where all this obsession with death came from. They appear innocent, but deep within, they are much more dangerous.
The fourth is a Shadowflame Reaver called Varkhiel. He is an assassin who uses both a dagger and a katana.
His affinity to shadows and flame is unparalleled, and while he couldn’t face someone like Veera or Elyndra in a one-on-one battle, killing them in his own way wouldn’t be too much of a headache.
He is built to walk in the shadows and harness their power.

The fifth is also dangerous in her own right. She is called Seraphyne, a Shadow Warlord. Her shadow and void affinity is also deadly, and if care is not taken, she might claim Varkhiel’s title as the lord of shadows.
However, while Varkhiel sneaks through the shadows, Seraphyne harnesses the shadows to combat in melee style.
Her armor is also terrifying.
She wears jagged, abyss-black armor laced with violet runes that glow faintly with cursed shadowy energy.
Her helmet is horned and faceless, with glowing purple eyes piercing through the visor.
The sixth is Velithra, Umbral Archer. She is someone Kent planned to give a technique he received from Faceless called Shadow Echo to.
Velithra is a deadly archer with an affinity for both shadow and the void.
What makes her dangerous is that aside from having the ability to use the shadows to transport her arrows, she can also add the void to them, making it nearly impossible to track her arrows.
That is just too much.
However, the technique Kent intended to give her would make it ten times harder to track her arrows, since with Shadow Echo, she can create misdirections that confuse anyone she aims her bow at.
Unity has just gained a rival—and perhaps a best friend.
The seventh is Selantra, the Lunar Warden. Unlike the others, she is a knight and also a warlock of some sort. But that is what makes her dangerous.
Aside from harnessing the power of the moon, her mastery of the greatsword makes her a terrifying warrior.
She is clad in obsidian armor veined with glowing golden glyphs.
Her helmet is sleek, with no visible eyes—only radiant golden slits glowing like starlight.
Her cloak trails shadows that ripple as if alive.
The last of them is Varyn, a knight whose nature also leans more toward an assassin.
His class is called Voidblade Knight, and just like Velithra, he also has an affinity for the void, but instead of shadows, his class leans toward soul art.
He and the Shade King will be best friends.
"Everyone, meet your new teammates," Kent said, introducing them all to the legion. Everyone surrounded them, wanting to know them better.
Kent used the time to take Princess Lovina into the tower, where he planned to awaken her True Name before climbing to the third floor.

chapters.title: Chapter 782: Vyrmyllia, The Toxic Bloom
paragraphs: Long before the Blooming Death Garden graced the Primordial Era.
Long before the Era of Warring Stars came to an end.
Long before the Fae were betrayed and cast out, becoming the Fallen Fae.
Long before the appearance of the Sovereign of the Seven Plagues.
Long before the True Primordial Killer appeared, there was nothing but war and destruction everywhere.
They called it the Era of Warring Stars, one that lasted for 7,000 years. It was the era that brought about the death of all six true Primordials and saw the rise of the one that killed them.
Long before her rise, she was but a humble child born into the Fae race. Of course, as a Fae, she was attuned with nature and loved by nature.
She loved plants and flowers, dedicating her time every day to shaping her flower garden into what she wanted it to be. Life was good. There was peace, and everyone was happy.
However, this peace was shattered when the Primordials went to war.
Millions of worlds were destroyed, and one of these worlds, the world of the Fae, was destroyed in the process and fell into the domain of darkness.
They lost everything, and in the process, even lost their connection to nature.
In no time, they started to go extinct, resulting in the death of millions.
Syrelith was on her deathbed at some point, only a few breaths away from succumbing to the curse that took hold of her race, when the spirit of the fallen Poison Mother Plant found her.
It was as if they were meant to find each other.
One of them was dying, and the other could not live without a vessel. However, if they were to come together and unite, their union would enable them to achieve their goals.
Naturally, both sought the extinction of the Primordials, for they had lost everything because of them. So they agreed, and in the end, what none of them expected happened.
The spirit of the Poison Mother Plant and a Fallen Fae turned out to be a recipe for disaster. Their union birthed the Duskwraith Nymph, first of her kind.
The Duskwraith Nymph is deeply attuned to toxins, mists, and nocturnal energy, with a body that naturally produces potent poisons and pheromones.
The loving and peaceful Fae girl became the incarnation of Poison
That was when she rose to fame, rising with the poison oozing from her body. Her trail reeks of poisons, and her steps left marks of poison in her wake.
Syrelith became the bane of the Primordials.

She created poisons that even beings heralded as the strongest in the universe grew weary of. They were scared of her, reaching the point where they had to stop fighting among themselves and band together to face her.
But they failed, for she had long transcended the limit of poison, rising to the stage that even being as strong as he, six True primordial couldn’t measure to.
They lost the battle miserably, but it created a legacy, one that the universe needed at that moment.

They called it the birth of the True Primordial Era, for when the last of them fell, the true era where the one called the Primordial Chaos Dragon rose—and unlike his predecessors, he walked the path of a True Primordial.

Although the legends containing her history were lost and long forgotten, those who knew something about the one heralded as the Toxic Queen called her the mother of the Primordial Era, for it was through her that peace had returned to the universe.
Kent respects and adores all his wives.
They are his reason for everything he does.
They are the ones he will run to when in pain.
The ones who will cater to his broken body when he is hurt.
The ones who will warm his bed at night.
He cherishes them.

However, gazing up at the sky, looking at the purple-haired beauty surrounded by toxic mist, holding a staff and clad in a purple dress, Kent couldn’t help feeling some deeper form of respect, adoration, and gratitude toward her.
In his heart, he felt like he wouldn’t be where he is now; he wouldn’t be alive had it not been for the beauty hovering in the air.
This alone made Kent feel like his connection to Princess Lovina runs much deeper than he might have thought.
He doesn’t know how he is linked to the rest of his wives, but he could tell that, in a way, he feels something much deeper toward Princess Lovina.
He intends to find out what that was.
However, first, her True Name, bestowed by the Universe, must be invoked.
"She rose as a Fallen Fae, bound with the Poison Mother Tree, and became the Duskwraith Nymph. Her name and legacy were known and renowned by all.
They called her the Mother of Poison. The killer of Leviathans. The executor of the Ancient Flame Beast King. The Creator of the Seven Poison Plagues.
Her legacy was poison, and her dominance was toxic. In the end, her name was known by all, earning the first-ever True Name ever given to a living being.
The universe called her Vyrmyllia, The Toxic Bloom, and so she would be called.
Rise, Vyrmyllia, the Mother of Poison. Rise, Vyrmyllia, The Toxic Bloom. Your true legacy has just begun. Rise, Vyrmyllia, for your destiny awaits."
The moment Kent invoked her True Name, a large tree, towering several kilometers high with a trunk larger than 100 meters, appeared behind her, exuding a potent poison mist.
"ROAR"

Suddenly, a large, perhaps the most enormous wingless dragon Kent had ever seen—be it in movies or reality—snaked around the giant tree, wrapping its massive body around the collosal trunk of the tree.
It turned its menacing gaze at Kent, whose body immediately froze.
The dragon was purple with eyes that were a mix of purple and red.
Kent felt his body evaded by a force far beyond his understanding.
This caused his body to start to fail suddenly. However, looking at the dragon and Lovina, he knew his life wasn’t in danger, so he didn’t panic.
Naturally, he was right not to panic, for before he passed out, a message flashed before his eyes, bringing a smile to his face as he fell into Lovina’s arms.
She appeared behind him and let him fall into her arms.
Ten days later, Kent opened his eyes, and the first thing he saw was the messages announcing his reward from Princess Lovina.
⟦You have attained Weak Poison Resistance⟧
⟦Your Poison Resistance has improved⟧
⟦You have attained High Poison Resistance⟧
"Well, it was flame before, now poison. I guess things do work out well in the end." Kent smiled, but then he felt something coming from his lower body.
He looked and saw Princess Lovina playing with Little Kent. Naturally, the next ten hours were spent in each other’s arms, making sure congratulations were in order.
"How do you feel?" Kent asked Princess Lovina, who was resting on his chest after the ten-hour marathon.
"I feel better than ever. Now, I can feel a much deeper understanding of poison and how to harness its power for my use."
"Good to hear that." Kent smiled, feeling happy for her. Now that she had received her True Name, only Unity remained to obtain hers, and all his wives would be set.
After resting in each other’s arms for a few minutes, they freshened up and went back to the dungeon so they could all head to the 3rd floor.

chapters.title: Chapter 783: Third Floor - The Unbreakable City (1) [Bonus]
paragraphs: The moment Kent and Princess Lovina returned to the second floor, everyone was ready to enter the third floor and handle whatever the dungeon had for them.
They’ve already found what they could on the second floor, so there was no need to stay there for long.
Kent opened the portal that led to the third floor, and everyone entered.
Kent and the legion appeared atop a mountain, standing several meters tall.

Before them lay a long, jagged valley leading to a large city, which was covered by a dome, even from far away, the ancient energy emanating from the tall and thick walls could be felt by Kent and his team.
A few raised their brows.
"That is one well-fortified city," Kaizo muttered, and everyone nodded. They can already sense the headache coming.
Kent and Vexthra began to read the details of the third floor, as that was the only way they could determine what needed to be done.
⟦Name: Planet Killer Dungeon⟧
⟦Floor Name: The Unbreakable City (3rd)⟧
⟦Power Level: Core Formation - Unknown⟧
⟦Description:
The third floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon houses the Unbreakable City — a city that stood unconquered for the last 50,000 years.

Long before all life went extinct in the Lupin Empire, King Renie, the tyrant and killer of the four ancient beast races, hired the grand architect Morse to design a city that could withstand anything below the immortal stage.
He was killed after spending 10,000 years designing, constructing, and fine-tuning everything to meet the expectations of King Renie.

In the end, when the Tyrant King and his 100,000 bloodthirsty soldiers massacred everyone, they hid behind the walls of the Unbreakable City, and regardless of what was used to strike the walls, not even a brick broke.
They remained untouchable and unbreakable.⟧
Objective:
↠ You must break the Unbreakable City and slaughter every last soldier hidden behind those walls. Failure is not an option.
↠ Beware of the mechanisms hidden within the city, and never try to fly over the walls or enter through the dome.
⟦Rewards⟧
↠ 10 Million Tower Points
↠ 10,000,000,000 Soul Essence
↠ Memory Key (Chaos)
↠ Supreme Bone Tempering Pill (Tier 12)

⟦Note: All drops will be stored inside the Tower storage. Additionally, it is advisable to thoroughly explore the floors using the dungeon map, as there are hidden items that can only be discovered with detailed examination.⟧
"Looks like things are about to get much more dangerous now," Kent said, and Vexthra nodded. They turned and looked at the looming city, and a sigh escaped Kent’s mouth.
"Our mission is simple. We have to break those walls and slaughter 100,001 bloodthirsty tigerkins hidden behind them." Kent smiled slightly, feeling the weight behind his words.
To his legion and wives, the mission sounded easy enough.
However, according to what Kent had read, the danger level could not be estimated, though he knew deep down it was much more harrowing than the description let on.
There is a danger posed by the walls, the dome, and the fact that the power level of the beings hidden behind the walls remains undetermined.
These three variables are what Kent and his legion would have to determine independently.

Of course, if she wanted to know, she could easily find out.

So she allowed them to live their own lives too. Her souls are now independent and can save her life in a situation where escape is the only option.
It’s peculiar, but having independent souls has its perks, and allowing them the freedom to do as they please isn’t too bad.
They couldn’t roam around on the outside, but since they were protected from all kinds of danger inside the tower, living a good life wasn’t something Unity had to worry about.

"I have a solution to our problem," Unity said, and everyone turned their attention to her.

chapters.title: Chapter 784: Third Floor - The Unbreakable City (2) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "So, after a quick deliberation with my Primordial Spirits, we came up with a way to break the walls." Unity paused to let her sisters and friends take in her words.
After ensuring she had the floor, she began to share her discovery.
"According to my Primordial Spirits, Camilla’s spear can break the wall. The reason is that she has a weapon spirit that can give her 5% of her power.
As I understand it, adding the power boost to Camilla’s own power will make breaking the wall easy.
However, there is a catch. She can only do it once, and after that, she will pass out for at least a month. But she has what it takes to break it.
Even if she fails, she will come close to breaking it, something we can continue on our own. Neomi can do it easily since she also has a weapon spirit to boost her attack."
Kent nodded, but he knew it would demand more than what Unity had just said.
"The question now is whether or not the attack will be enough.
This whole floor reeks of conspiracy. I have a feeling the immortal-level attack they are asking for is for the attack to contain an immortal aura," Kent said, making everyone sigh.
"Of course, we have one solution, and we will try it, but before we do that, we must come up with another method that, should the first attack fail, we can adopt.
I already have one in mind, which I planned on using at first, but now, Camilla will be attacking first, and the second will be me. Should the two of us fail, Neomi, you can also go."
Kent wanted to keep all their cards on the table. The third floor reeks of danger, and he could feel it, so he wasn’t about to act nonchalant.
He knew a lot would be involved in clearing it, and so the planning had to be perfect. There can’t be any mistake in executing any of the plans.
"So the plan is simple. Camilla will open for us, and while we all believe she will give it her all, we should also be ready in case her attack isn’t sufficient.
Now, if her attack doesn’t take down the wall, I will follow up with my attack and hope that does the job. Now, should that one too fail, Neomi, you will go.
However, I believe we can handle it; even Camilla is enough," Kent smiled, knowing full well things can go both ways.
"Now, should the wall come down, there are 100,001 bloodthirsty warriors who would surely want our heads and drink our blood.
You don’t have to think about what to do, for the odds are already against us, so go all out. Please don’t hold back, for they surely wouldn’t hold back against us."
"Just get the wall down and the rest will be handled," Kaizo said, already itching to get into battle.
Kent looked at Camilla. "Are you up for it?"
She nodded. "Too bad I won’t be able to fight with you all after using my attack." She smiled, though the smile didn’t reach her eyes. It was plain as day she wanted to join the battle.
But she also understood her role and was happy to do it.
"Don’t worry about it. You will have the chance to fight in the subsequent ones." Kent patted her head, making sure she was alright.
They began to prepare, as their initial plan to handle the 3rd level had encountered a roadblock.
Kent held Vexthra’s hand and moved her to the side. "The moment Camilla unleashes her attack, take her to the tower and stay there.

If you were here, I have a feeling you would be tempted to intervene should the odd turn out to be more than we can handle, and I don’t have to remind you that doing so will be bad for you and everyone else."
"I understand." Vexthra sighed. She had expected to be able to use her power here, considering it is a unique dungeon, but it turned out she had hoped for too much.
In a unique world, she can use her god abilities, but here, even a slight trace of her divine energy will call the heavenly laws’ attention to her.
It was one of the reasons why she was learning to become human again.
She wants to know how to feel human and behave like one, so that when she suppresses her power to the stage of a mortal, she won’t instinctively use her divine powers.
Her progress is relatively slow, but she is doing her best.
"Don’t worry, the tower will allow you to watch everything." Kent kissed her and then moved to the edge of the mountain.
’What a strange dungeon.’
[The Unbreakable City - Inside Tyrant Throne Room]
Inside a dimly lit room filled with the metallic stench of blood sat a menacing humanoid figure. He was muscular, and even in his sitting posture, his height was about 7 feet.
This showed that his standing height would be a sight to behold. He sat in a bone throne featuring an amalgamation of different bones connected.
Battle scars littered his chest and hands.
His left arm, as thick as it could get, rested on the armrest of his throne, with his fist supporting his left jaw.
The look in his eyes was calm and calculating. However, a sudden bang on the door caused his eyes to flash crimson. The figure who entered the hall came to a halt and then went to his knees.
"I am sorry, my King... I never meant to disturb your rest, but we have a situation." For a moment, the air inside the hall stopped.
The tigerkin who made the report felt his heart beat slow down, already knowing that if his excuse wasn’t bought, things would get dark for him.
Luckily for him, his death didn’t come. "Speak."
"Our spy birds spotted enemies 2 miles from here, and judging by how they are studying the city, they might attack anytime from now. What are your orders?"
"How many are they, and what are their power levels?" the tiger king asked.
"They are all at the peak of the Core Formation stage, with only one still at the Root Sovereign stage. We counted about 30 of them, but their number may exceed that."
The tiger king raised his head slightly and looked at the tiger kneeling on the floor.

For a moment, the thought of killing him flashed across his eyes, but knowing that killing someone like him would cost him a Spirit King, he flicked his hand, and the tiger was sent flying out of the throne room.
"Don’t bother me with useless reports like this again. Try again and you won’t live to see the next day." His tone was calm, but those who heard it felt their bodies freeze for a moment.
As a Spirit Sovereign, only three levels away from becoming a Spirit Lord, his mere words were enough to make Spirit Emperors and below shudder and pee their pants.
’Even Spirit Kings failed to breach my unbreakable walls, what could a bunch of Core Formation experts do?’
He rested his left jaw on his fist again and closed his eyes. To him, Kent and his team were mere bugs he could crush under his foot.
If only he knew what was coming...

chapters.title: Chapter 785: Third Floor - The Unbreakable City (3)
paragraphs: Within ten minutes, everyone was ready.
Kent studied them and nodded.
They were indeed ready to face their first actual battle, one that would determine whether they were truly as impressive as they claimed.
"Remember, should things go wrong, you should execute plan B. That will take care of whatever might go wrong.
Plans C and D are for when we really need them.
"Dont worry, Master, we wouldn’t need Plan B, just Plan A is enough to handle them." Kaizo, of course, had to brag.
But his words do make sense; they are strong enough to use A, so plan B would be for when they are getting close to the danger on the higher floors.

"Let’s go," Kent commanded, and they started flying toward the city. Camilla would attack when they were 5 km away from the city. It was also the right spot for Kent to use his attack should Camilla fail.
As for Neomi, she would move much closer to the city.
Camilla held her spear as she talked to it. Well, the spirit inside was talking to her. It is weird that the most important thing was that they were talking.
"Are you sure? Your current body can only handle 5% of my power. Using 7% will not only hurt like hell, but you might not be able to fight for half a year."
"Provided I don’t die, I can handle it. This is a big deal to me." Camilla looked at Kent from the corner of her eye. "I can’t fail him."
The weapon spirit didn’t say anything for a few seconds until a sigh escaped her lips.
"You are just as stubborn as our first sister."
Camilla smiled. "I guess she and I will get along when she awakens."
"That I am sure you two will."
"Very well, I will give you 7% of my energy, but do well to stay awake and watch your handiwork do what it was intended to do before passing out."
"I will."
With plans in order, Camilla was prepared to unleash her strongest move, one she never thought she would be using anytime soon.
But since the situation called for it, she would be using it to give her friends a chance to clear the third floor of the dungeon.
When they were 5 km away from the city, they came to a halt.
"They know we are here," Nyxira said, spinning her dagger. She could see far ahead, and so she noticed the figures standing on the tall, thick wall.
"Then we should greet them." Kent turned to Camilla, who nodded and flew into the air.
After rising about 20 meters above the ground, her body was immediately enveloped in a potent golden energy.
She then lifted her spear and threw it into the air, pointing its tip toward the city.
She sighed and formed a seal.
The moment the first seal was formed, the spear started to spin. She formed another seal, and this time, instead of the spear spinning much faster, a runic circle appeared around the spinning spear.
She formed three more seals, causing three more runic circles to appear around the spear.
"Are you ready?" Lynn, the weapon spirit, asked, and Camilla nodded.
"It is going to hurt like hell, so brace yourself."
Camilla mentally prepared herself for the pain, and just when the first strand of energy entered her body, she felt her body tense, then a mind-numbing pain entered both her mind and body.
She gritted her teeth as more energy was poured into her body.

However, instead of screaming, she was forming the hand seal in rapid succession. In no time, 40 runic circles appeared around the spear, and looking at the energy coming from the spear, it was safe to say it had become a weapon even Spirit Lords would fear.
But Camilla didn’t stop there. She went further and continued to form more hand seals, adding more circles to the spear.
Soon, she started bleeding through her nose and mouth.
Kent panicked and wanted to stop her, but Vexthra stopped him.
"She has made her decision, so allow her. Stopping her would do more damage than what she is sustaining now."
Kent gritted his teeth as blood continued to flow now from even Camilla’s eyes and ears. Soon, the energy stopped entering her body, but by then, 99 circles appeared around the spear.
Camilla felt her body giving out, but she gritted her teeth and managed to form the 100th circle before pointing toward the city wall.
"Spear of Down." Her voice turned dull and weak, a sign that she was weakened. But she willed herself to activate the attack. "Point... of... No... Return."
The moment she activated the skill, the spinning spear came to a halt. Then it flashed forward, streaking toward the city like a bolt of lightning.
Atop the city walls, the tigers watching Kent and his team were at first laughing at them. This wasn’t their first rodeo.
Once in a while, people would come attacking them; however, no matter how hard they tried, the walls stood firm, not even a dent forming on the surface.

So, watching Kent and his team get ready to attack was like another day of entertainment for them. However, when they saw Camilla point toward them, their bodies froze for the first time since the city was built.
They all felt their blood run cold, and even within the city, thousands of tigers felt their bodies freeze in place.
Those about to put food in their mouths froze in place, and even those falling froze mid-fall. It was like time had suddenly frozen.
Even inside the throne room, King Renie felt a danger he had never felt before was over him, forcing him to burst out of the room and appear on the city walls.
However, he was a second too late, for the spear had already touched the wall.

For a moment, nothing happened; then a crack appeared, and like a nuclear explosion, a powerful blast rocked the wall, tearing a large chunk, approximately 500 meters in diameter, away and opening a way into the city for the first time since it was built.
Thousands died instantly, and even the king, who appeared on the city wall just a second before the explosion, was thrown across the city, crashing through several buildings.
Kent caught Camilla before she could fall to the ground.
"I... I did it," she said weakly. Kent nodded and wiped the blood from her eyes and mouth.
"You did, and I am proud of you. For now, rest. We will handle the rest," Kent said, but Camilla passed out before she could hear him.
"Take her away, Vex." Vexthra nodded and vanished into the tower, sending Camilla straight into the Yin pool.
She began channeling her energy into her body, doing her best to repair the damage that had occurred. Gaia and her sister appeared the next instant, bringing loads of healing potions.
Meanwhile, outside, Kent pointed his sword at the city and said, "Kill them all."
He wasn’t even done when two golden flame wheels appeared on the sides of his left and right feet. He activated the 5th form of the [Firestep Divine Dance].
It was one of the divine-grade techniques he had learned from the Flame Tower. The first form, [Flame Wheels], is activated.

With a single movement, he was inside the city, leaving a trail of golden flame behind him. The sudden movement took his legion aback, but they also moved, and attacks started to rain down on the now breakable city.
Kent moved through the city, killing anyone in his path while searching for King Renie.
Seeing the pain Camilla went through to break down the city made him mad, so Kent wanted the bastard’s blood as compensation.

sentences.text: Within ten minutes, everyone was ready.
Kent studied them and nodded.
They were indeed ready to face their first actual battle, one that would determine whether they were truly as impressive as they claimed.
"Remember, should things go wrong, you should execute plan B.
That will take care of whatever might go wrong.
Plans C and D are for when we really need them.
"Dont worry, Master, we wouldn’t need Plan B, just Plan A is enough to handle them." Kaizo, of course, had to brag.
But his words do make sense; they are strong enough to use A, so plan B would be for when they are getting close to the danger on the higher floors.
"Let’s go," Kent commanded, and they started flying toward the city.
Camilla would attack when they were 5 km away from the city.
It was also the right spot for Kent to use his attack should Camilla fail.
As for Neomi, she would move much closer to the city.
Camilla held her spear as she talked to it.
Well, the spirit inside was talking to her.
It is weird that the most important thing was that they were talking.
"Are you sure?
Your current body can only handle 5% of my power.
Using 7% will not only hurt like hell, but you might not be able to fight for half a year."
"Provided I don’t die, I can handle it.
This is a big deal to me." Camilla looked at Kent from the corner of her eye.
"I can’t fail him."
The weapon spirit didn’t say anything for a few seconds until a sigh escaped her lips.
"You are just as stubborn as our first sister."
Camilla smiled.
"I guess she and I will get along when she awakens."
"That I am sure you two will."
"Very well, I will give you 7% of my energy, but do well to stay awake and watch your handiwork do what it was intended to do before passing out."
"I will."
With plans in order, Camilla was prepared to unleash her strongest move, one she never thought she would be using anytime soon.
But since the situation called for it, she would be using it to give her friends a chance to clear the third floor of the dungeon.
When they were 5 km away from the city, they came to a halt.
"They know we are here," Nyxira said, spinning her dagger.
She could see far ahead, and so she noticed the figures standing on the tall, thick wall.
"Then we should greet them." Kent turned to Camilla, who nodded and flew into the air.
After rising about 20 meters above the ground, her body was immediately enveloped in a potent golden energy.
She then lifted her spear and threw it into the air, pointing its tip toward the city.
She sighed and formed a seal.
The moment the first seal was formed, the spear started to spin.
She formed another seal, and this time, instead of the spear spinning much faster, a runic circle appeared around the spinning spear.
She formed three more seals, causing three more runic circles to appear around the spear.
"Are you ready?" Lynn, the weapon spirit, asked, and Camilla nodded.
"It is going to hurt like hell, so brace yourself."
Camilla mentally prepared herself for the pain, and just when the first strand of energy entered her body, she felt her body tense, then a mind-numbing pain entered both her mind and body.
She gritted her teeth as more energy was poured into her body.
However, instead of screaming, she was forming the hand seal in rapid succession.
In no time, 40 runic circles appeared around the spear, and looking at the energy coming from the spear, it was safe to say it had become a weapon even Spirit Lords would fear.
But Camilla didn’t stop there.
She went further and continued to form more hand seals, adding more circles to the spear.
Soon, she started bleeding through her nose and mouth.
Kent panicked and wanted to stop her, but Vexthra stopped him.
"She has made her decision, so allow her.
Stopping her would do more damage than what she is sustaining now."
Kent gritted his teeth as blood continued to flow now from even Camilla’s eyes and ears.
Soon, the energy stopped entering her body, but by then, 99 circles appeared around the spear.
Camilla felt her body giving out, but she gritted her teeth and managed to form the 100th circle before pointing toward the city wall.
"Spear of Down." Her voice turned dull and weak, a sign that she was weakened.
But she willed herself to activate the attack.
"Point... of...
No...
Return."
The moment she activated the skill, the spinning spear came to a halt.
Then it flashed forward, streaking toward the city like a bolt of lightning.
Atop the city walls, the tigers watching Kent and his team were at first laughing at them.
This wasn’t their first rodeo.
Once in a while, people would come attacking them; however, no matter how hard they tried, the walls stood firm, not even a dent forming on the surface.
So, watching Kent and his team get ready to attack was like another day of entertainment for them.
However, when they saw Camilla point toward them, their bodies froze for the first time since the city was built.
They all felt their blood run cold, and even within the city, thousands of tigers felt their bodies freeze in place.
Those about to put food in their mouths froze in place, and even those falling froze mid-fall.
It was like time had suddenly frozen.
Even inside the throne room, King Renie felt a danger he had never felt before was over him, forcing him to burst out of the room and appear on the city walls.
However, he was a second too late, for the spear had already touched the wall.

For a moment, nothing happened; then a crack appeared, and like a nuclear explosion, a powerful blast rocked the wall, tearing a large chunk, approximately 500 meters in diameter, away and opening a way into the city for the first time since it was built.
Thousands died instantly, and even the king, who appeared on the city wall just a second before the explosion, was thrown across the city, crashing through several buildings.
Kent caught Camilla before she could fall to the ground.
I did it," she said weakly.
Kent nodded and wiped the blood from her eyes and mouth.
"You did, and I am proud of you.
For now, rest.
We will handle the rest," Kent said, but Camilla passed out before she could hear him.
"Take her away, Vex." Vexthra nodded and vanished into the tower, sending Camilla straight into the Yin pool.
She began channeling her energy into her body, doing her best to repair the damage that had occurred.
Gaia and her sister appeared the next instant, bringing loads of healing potions.
Meanwhile, outside, Kent pointed his sword at the city and said, "Kill them all."
He wasn’t even done when two golden flame wheels appeared on the sides of his left and right feet.
He activated the 5th form of the [Firestep Divine Dance].
It was one of the divine-grade techniques he had learned from the Flame Tower.
The first form, [Flame Wheels], is activated.
With a single movement, he was inside the city, leaving a trail of golden flame behind him.
The sudden movement took his legion aback, but they also moved, and attacks started to rain down on the now breakable city.
Kent moved through the city, killing anyone in his path while searching for King Renie.
Seeing the pain Camilla went through to break down the city made him mad, so Kent wanted the bastard’s blood as compensation.

chapters.title: Chapter 786: Third Floor - The Unbreakable City (4)
paragraphs: "Mountain Fist"
Kaizo landed hard on the ground, creating a powerful shockwave that threw over a hundred tigerkins into the air.
"Lightning Barrage"
Unity arrived with lightning arrows, killing as many as she could. She and Kaizo already had this dynamic in place.
Kaizo attacked with a terrifying opening, and then Unity followed with rapid shots to handle those who were knocked off their feet.

But it wasn’t only Kaizo and Unity who had this dynamic. Most of the legion members had already formed their mini teams, with the recent one being between Vaelros and Velithra, the new archer added to the undead legion.
It turns out that being on the same side and in the same legions has its perks.
"Chainstorm Requiem"
Vaelros unleashed his attack, sending out thousands of chains that efficiently bound the tigerkins, giving Velithra the chance to go for immediate kills.
She unleashed shadow arrows, hundreds of them. The arrows came through the shadows of the bounded tigers, killing from the direction of their shadows.
Unlike Unity, who shot her arrows through the air, Velithra shot hers through the shadows, making the entire process look bone-chilling.
All the tigers who were unfortunate to be the recipients of her arrow didn’t even know how they died.
The harem of dangerous ladies was also going all out, killing as quickly as they could.
Considering their sister had to put her life on the line to give them a chance at winning, they weren’t giving the tigers a chance to breathe.
Now that the walls were down, the tigerkins were forced to assume battle positions. However, their stance was being broken by Kent, who was moving faster than the eye could track.
The rings on his heels were like wheels propelling him forward at a speed that not even a Spirit Emperor could track.

Of course, Kent wasn’t using his actual speed, for that would just be too fast, and he might not be able to focus, so he was moving at half his speed, but even so, the tigers couldn’t track him at all.
Soon, Kent spotted King Renie within the rubble created when he was sent flying by Camilla’s attack.
Kent moved, and before the Tiger King could understand what was going on, dozens of sword arcs appeared before him, sending him flying back.
His body slammed through many buildings again, sending him crashing through, creating numerous shockwaves.
When he regained his footing, a dangerous look appeared in his eyes as his aura flared, shaking the very ground he stood on.
"Who are you?" King Renie asked, looking coldly at Kent.
One minute ago, he had received a report that some core formation experts were about to attack them. He threw out the reporter for reporting such a useless thing.
However, the next second, his city walls, which had stood unbroken for 50,000 years, came tumbling down.

The sheer shock he found himself in was one he hadn’t expected. So he wanted to know who dared break down her walls, and if possible, after he won, he would seek out the family of Kent and his friends and slaughter them all.
However, Kent wasn’t in the mood to talk.
To him, every second wasted was a second longer he stayed away from Camilla, considering she had passed out in his arms.

So, instead of answering, Kent moved, and within a second, a dozen more attacks were unleashed, forcing King Renie to take out a great sword, which was immediately engulfed in a potent, profound sword aura.
He was also a swordsman, and judging by the thickness of the aura on the sword, he had already reached the sword king stage, but Kent didn’t care.
He was moving, unleashing attacks, forcing the king into defense with no hope of ever getting a chance to go on the offense.
"Void Cleave"

Kent unleashed the second form of his Annihilation sword technique, forcing out a powerful sword arc. King Renie crossed the sword on his chest, causing the powerful sword arc to slam into it, sending him flying.
"Unending Spear Rain"
Kent unleashed a flame art that he had learned from the Flame Tower. In the air, hundreds of golden flame spears appeared and started raining down on the tiger king.
The attacks slammed into his body, sending him flying to the ground and causing him to crash into it with a shockwave and a crater.
"Incinerating Spear"
Kent followed up with the next attack, forcing the tiger king into a corner. Breaking free would be hard. Kent wasn’t taking his opponent lightly.
He recognized the danger, and so he knew the moment the Tiger King managed to break free from his attacks would be when he would be put into danger.
So, he was doing everything in his power to wear him down and kill him before that could happen.
The two flame skills he unleashed were part of a seven-form divine-grade attacking flame art called [Flaming Spear of Judgment].
Kent unleashed the first and second forms, and so far, the Tiger King is being overwhelmed, showing that a divine-grade technique is not simple at all.
Kent was keeping the tiger king down, and that alone was admirable, considering he was fighting someone four realms above him.
"Kaizo, go hold back that Spirit Emperor," Unity commanded, and Kaizo jumped forward at a speed that left lightning trailing behind him.
So far, the core formation experts among the thousands of tigerkins were just a few. The main army was made up of Spirit Ascension and Spirit Kings.

However, while their numbers were overwhelming, the legion was holding them back. They weren’t too much of a headache, considering someone like Princess Lovina already had a large chunk of the battlefield under control.
Her poison was spreading everywhere. So far, she had killed hundreds and more yet to die or succumb ot her poison.
But even with her overwhelming display of poison mastery, there were perhaps a few hundred Spirit Emperors and tens of thousands of spirit kings. They were the danger everyone was watching out for.
Veydris and Irina had already started looking for such dangers to handle before they reach a level they can’t handle. For now, they are taking them out one by one.
But while they were making some progress, they also couldn’t ignore the rest of the bloodthirsty Tiger Army.
If anything, they were being slowed down by the small flies.
Thankfully, Unity, with the help of her Primordial Spirits, was managing to pick the Spirit Emperors out.
But she wasn’t going for the kill, seeing her main job was to handle the tigers sneaking up on her friends and sister.
They didn’t have the numbers on their side, so someone like her, who could kill multiple targets simultaneously, wasn’t the ideal person to engage in a one-on-one battle with Spirit Emperors.
However, Kaizo was perfect for that job, and as one of the strongest in the legion, handling a Spirit Emperor shouldn’t be a big deal for him.
Though it wouldn’t be an easy battle, Kaizo isn’t weak. Aetheris, the flame giant, was also handling the Spirit Emperors.
Veera was on standby to raise the dead to add to her side.

She already had more than enough undead working hard to handle the horde of tigers. Most of her undead were being killed, but with more dead bodies hitting the ground every second, she wasn’t complaining.

If she could, she would love to have more than enough undead for the next battle, but since she had started to overhaul her undead, opting for quality over quantity, for now, she was only building a fodder undead army—the kind she could waste in battle and wouldn’t feel a thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 787: Third Floor - The Unbreakable City (5) [Bonus]
paragraphs: [Power of Shara – Neomi’s POV]
The one catalyst fueling everyone’s attack was the fact that Camilla had placed her life in danger to give them this chance to attack the tigers.
One person most affected by Camilla’s display was Neomi.
They are sisters, but in the harem, the two mostly train together because they are both spear users. In a way, they are closer than one might expect.
So, watching her sister get hurt just to unleash an attack that they all needed to get into the city, brought out a side of her she had hidden deep within her.
Neomi has three forms.
The first is her standard, easy-going form. That side of her is for living her day-to-day life. One could say she even looks harmless in that form, which, in a way, she was indeed harmless.
However, the second form, the one called Shara, the mother of killers, was the one most affected after witnessing Camilla’s painful attack.
So, the moment the walls came down and Kent gave the order to begin attacking, she was among the first to move.
Within minutes, she started reaping lives like ripe fruits.
She started killing much faster; however, as the minutes passed, her true self-the side of Shara she would love to suppress for now—began to awaken.
As more deaths occurred on the battlefield, her dangerous side began to awaken, turning her eyes crimson to the point that faint, smoke-like red mist started to appear in the corners of her eyes.
At first, only her eyes changed.
However, her speed then began to increase.

However, as the minutes went by and more deaths continued to occur, her killing speed also increased, and then her body started exuding a rather potent death aura—the kind that made the tigers start to fear for their lives.
At any moment, wherever she looked, or whoever she looked at, they froze in place. The Spirit Ascension and Core Formation experts were even dropping dead just by sensing her gaze.
Though she remained sane, the danger coming from her wasn’t one the tigers were having a good time handling.
Shara was the most dangerous side of her, and that side is only used when she wants to commit a massacre. It was safe to say she was indeed committing a massacre.
Although she would one day awaken all of her form as Shara, for now, she was merely wearing the form of the mother of killers.
But soon, she will become the True Mother of killers, the one who can command death and make it do her bidding.
After all, in the entire universe, she was the only one feared by death. Not even the Primordial Chaos Dragon made death tremble like she did.
[The Joker (Lani’s) POV]
One disturbing aspect of Lani is her laughter, which always accompanies her whenever she is killing. To the masses, it might seem like she were some maniac who enjoys the thrill of killing.
Of course, anyone who witnesses her kill will say that, for it isn’t normal to laugh like a maniac while death and destruction follow her.
However, while she indeed laughs while she kills, the laughter isn’t a happy one. To Lani, this laughter contained unknown pain and regret.
At first, it was a normal thing for her, but now that she had awakened her True name and Blood, she had no idea where they came from.
She never knew why she laughs when killing or how it happens.
However, today she felt where the laughter was coming from. This laughter contains the sadness of witnessing her sister risk her life to give them a fighting chance.
So, without even knowing how to put her emotions under control, her laughter rang out, sending chills down the body of the tigers.
"Hahahaha..."
She flashed across the battlefield, and behind her lay the heads of dozens of Tigerkins who had no idea how they died.
"Hahahaha..."
She appeared behind a Spirit King tiger who was sneaking up on Alina, beheading it before it could even have a shot at taking her out.
Alina wasn’t done with her array. It had already been 12 minutes into the battle, but she wasn’t done with her array.

Unity told her from the start of the battle to draw an attacking array, the kind that would end the battle for them, and so she was at it for the past 12 minutes, already having thousands of runes in the air.

Protecting her was Vari herself. She wielded her scythe, making sure the danger was neutralized before they could even think of attacking the beautiful Alina, who was hovering in the air, drawing thousands of runes.
[Kent’s POV]
Perhaps the one most affected by Camilla’s decision was Kent, who, for the first time, panicked. Seeing Camilla like that pulled on his heartstrings.

This was why, instead of using this battle as a chance to test how much he could go into close combat with his sword, he instead switched to using his flame arts and a few sword attacks if needed to handle the Level 7 Spirit Sovereign.
From the start of the battle, when Kent opened with the sword arcs, he recognized this wasn’t going to be an easy battle.
He knew the attack he used from the start would have killed anyone below the Spirit Lord stage. However, the Tiger King sustained only minor damage.
Of course, if he had unleashed all 450 sword arcs, he might have had a much different outcome. However, he was sure he wouldn’t have succeeded in killing the tiger king even with 450 sword arcs.
So Kent became aware that if he didn’t take his opponent seriously, this might be his first defeat. This was why he started bombarding the Spirit King with attacks that could break anyone.
However, while Kent was making so much progress, the moment he started using the [Spear Flame Judgment] technique, he began to sense something that made him wonder just how any of it was possible.
One of his requirements to become a Sword Saint was to create the foundation for three sword techniques.
So far, he had made zero progress on that front. He had tried to comprehend one sword technique a while back, but failed

However, the moment the flame spears started raining down on the Tiger King, Kent sensed the change. He began to see a pattern in something he had theorized about and had even witnessed Nara do the same.
Blending sword arcs with elements and laws.
So far, Kent doesn’t know any law, but he has two elements. The flame element is his strongest, so he intends to see if he can use it.
He can already sense a pattern that would allow him to merge flame, sword qi, and intent into an attack.
However, Kent wasn’t about to start when he knew he would be dividing his attention.
’So it looks like I will have to put my life in danger just to make this moment happen.’

Kent sighed in his heart and continued to attack the Tiger King as his mind formed the patterns, giving him a clear understanding of what he needed to do if he wanted to make this attack come together.
Slowly, the battle was going in Kent’s favor.
However, something else was happening underground, inside a prison cell that even Kent wasn’t aware of.
Deep underground, inside a fortified cell, an evil was slowly stirring.

So, without even knowing how to put her emotions under control, her laughter rang out, sending chills down the body of the tigers.
"Hahahaha..."
She flashed across the battlefield, and behind her lay the heads of dozens of Tigerkins who had no idea how they died.
"Hahahaha..."
She appeared behind a Spirit King tiger who was sneaking up on Alina, beheading it before it could even have a shot at taking her out.
Alina wasn’t done with her array.
It had already been 12 minutes into the battle, but she wasn’t done with her array.

Unity told her from the start of the battle to draw an attacking array, the kind that would end the battle for them, and so she was at it for the past 12 minutes, already having thousands of runes in the air.
Protecting her was Vari herself.
She wielded her scythe, making sure the danger was neutralized before they could even think of attacking the beautiful Alina, who was hovering in the air, drawing thousands of runes.
[Kent’s POV]
Perhaps the one most affected by Camilla’s decision was Kent, who, for the first time, panicked.
Seeing Camilla like that pulled on his heartstrings.

This was why, instead of using this battle as a chance to test how much he could go into close combat with his sword, he instead switched to using his flame arts and a few sword attacks if needed to handle the Level 7 Spirit Sovereign.
From the start of the battle, when Kent opened with the sword arcs, he recognized this wasn’t going to be an easy battle.
He knew the attack he used from the start would have killed anyone below the Spirit Lord stage.
However, the Tiger King sustained only minor damage.
Of course, if he had unleashed all 450 sword arcs, he might have had a much different outcome.
However, he was sure he wouldn’t have succeeded in killing the tiger king even with 450 sword arcs.
So Kent became aware that if he didn’t take his opponent seriously, this might be his first defeat.
This was why he started bombarding the Spirit King with attacks that could break anyone.
However, while Kent was making so much progress, the moment he started using the [Spear Flame Judgment] technique, he began to sense something that made him wonder just how any of it was possible.
One of his requirements to become a Sword Saint was to create the foundation for three sword techniques.
So far, he had made zero progress on that front.
He had tried to comprehend one sword technique a while back, but failed
However, the moment the flame spears started raining down on the Tiger King, Kent sensed the change.
He began to see a pattern in something he had theorized about and had even witnessed Nara do the same.
Blending sword arcs with elements and laws.
So far, Kent doesn’t know any law, but he has two elements.
The flame element is his strongest, so he intends to see if he can use it.
He can already sense a pattern that would allow him to merge flame, sword qi, and intent into an attack.
However, Kent wasn’t about to start when he knew he would be dividing his attention.
’So it looks like I will have to put my life in danger just to make this moment happen.’

Kent sighed in his heart and continued to attack the Tiger King as his mind formed the patterns, giving him a clear understanding of what he needed to do if he wanted to make this attack come together.
Slowly, the battle was going in Kent’s favor.
However, something else was happening underground, inside a prison cell that even Kent wasn’t aware of.
Deep underground, inside a fortified cell, an evil was slowly stirring.

chapters.title: Chapter 788: Third Floor - The Unbreakable City (6) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Damnit... just die already."
Krex, formerly known as Jacob Ashland, Kent’s first servant, cursed as he narrowly evaded a sword slash from a Spirit Ascension-stage Tigerkin.
Krex is only a Level 7 Root Sovereign, so this battle wasn’t going in his favor. However, regardless of the odds surrounding him, he was still alive and had managed to kill quite a few Tigerkins.
This alone shows Krex Nithal, the undying cockroach, lives up to his name.

However, while he was keeping his life by killing his fair share of enemies, he could sense the danger mounting, and as someone who is a survivalist, he had already started looking for ways to stay alive in the end.
It wasn’t fear that made him look for ways to keep his life.
It is his nature as the undying cockroach.
Regardless of the situation, living, in the end, is what he prioritizes, and so far, he has been doing just that. Meanwhile, Kaizo was also finally feeling the heat of the battle.
It had already been 30 minutes into the battle, but the number of enemies left still counted in the thousands, showing that a hundred thousand isn’t a small number.
Kaizo had killed quite a few Spirit Emperor tigers, but the sheer number of tigers was getting to him. And it wasn’t just him; almost everyone started to tire.
They are strong, but when it comes to fighting against those realms higher than them and even numbers in the hundreds of thousands, the pressure will get to them.
However, despite being outnumbered and showing signs of tiredness, their killing speed never slowed down.
’I need to kill this bastard in the next five minutes before things get dark for them. Also, why do I feel like my life is in danger?’
Kent said as he landed a powerful kick on the tiger king’s face, sending him crashing down. Kent began to sense a danger to his life.
At first, he thought it was because he couldn’t handle the tiger king. But now, he knew it was something else.
This made him start to take extra caution.
However, he was also working on his sword foundation, which he estimated would be done within the next five minutes.
But if the danger he was feeling came sooner than he expected, he would be forced to use his trump cards, which in this case would mean abandoning his sword foundation technique.
Currently, he either kills the Tiger King using the Transcendent Heavenly Sword Technique or continues to use him to build his sword foundation technique.
However, doing so would mean he would have to abandon the only chance to create a sword foundation technique.
The feeling he was getting from his battle with the Tiger King didn’t come often.
So, as someone who has a passive skill called Clarity, Kent knew it was his only chance to make the most out of the moment.
He looked at his legion and, seeing them still going hard, he knew the battle wasn’t over yet. They are tired, but they continue to kill.
"I need to hurry with forming the patterns of the sword technique, and then I can kill this bastard."
Kent pressed on and soon, three minutes had passed. However, while he was drawing closer to creating the sword technique, or at least the foundation for it, he could sense he was out of time.

That was because, just as he was feeling the danger, his teammate could also sense it, and this alone made them feel heavy. And to make matters worse, the Tiger King, sensing the change in the air, started laughing.
"What is funny?" Kent asked, unleashing a sword arc. The Tiger King blocked the attack, but he was sent flying.
However, despite crashing hard on the ground, the Tiger King didn’t stop laughing. In a way, Kent felt like the bastard was mocking him.
"I have changed my mind. I won’t use the Transcendent Heavenly Sword Technique to kill him. I will use that Flame Art to roast him and ensure he dies screaming."
"Today, none of you will be living here alive," King Renie said, laughing. "Even if I die, the ancient Hellhound chained and fed for the past 50,000 years will ensure you all do not live here alive."
The moment his words came out, a danger notice appeared before Kent’s vision.
⟦Danger: A Peak Spirit Lord Detected⟧
The message was simple, yet it conveyed all Kent needed to know. Naturally, he didn’t anticipate this outcome, but he wasn’t surprised that something like this had happened.

He had already sensed something dangerous when he saw the description of the third floor, so he expected this in a way, and now that he saw the danger hidden, he knew it was time for his team to end their battle.
Their plan A has failed.

"It is quite unfortunate, but I guess they will have fun in the next one." Kent sighed and then looked toward one part of the city where a 120-meter-tall Hellhound, radiating a powerful aura of a peak Spirit Lord, appeared.
"It is way stronger than the tyrant King in Fedora," Kent smirked, and then a sigh escaped his lips.
[Val, my love, why don’t you do me the honor and kill that brute? You have 15 minutes.]
Val, who had just severed the body of a Spirit King Tiger, smiled when Kent’s voice entered her head. She looked toward the west of the city, and there, she saw the danger coming toward them.
She moved, and soon she was away from the true battle. When she was a couple of kilometers away, she came to a halt and sighed.
She looked at the Hellhound, and then a sigh escaped her mouth again.
"Moon Goddess Descent."
The moment the words left her mouth, her aura changed from the subtle lunar aura to a more refined, much stronger, and divine one.
Her goddess form had activated, and for the next 15 minutes, she would be the moon goddess. It’s safe to say the Hellhound was as good as dead.
Her sisters and teammates sensed her aura and knew that the second plan Kent had discussed long before entering the Planet Killer dungeon was in effect.
They all sighed and started to retreat. Soon, all of them were away from the battlefield, defeat written all over their faces.
The only ones left were Alina, Mara, Nara, Lani, Vari, Ankaara, Veera, Irina, and Unity. They pressed their palms against Alina’s back, channeling their energy into her body.
The formation she was about to activate was beyond her limit, so she needed energy from her sisters.

Alina took a small stone from her Grid space and made it suspend in the air. With a defeated sigh, she channeled her energy into one of the masterpieces her primordial spirit had given her before regressing to tier 1.
"Odyssey of Death."
An extensive array formation appeared in the air, spreading across the entire city. Within three seconds, the bodies of the 67,000 tigers left on the ground and those in the air were frozen in place.
Alina looked at them with lazy eyes and snapped her fingers.
"Rain of Death."
Spears made of black flames started raining down from the frozen tigers. It was devastating to watch. Within two minutes, every last tiger was reduced to ash.
Alina’s face was pale, and the ladies supplying her with the energy were also pale, some even gasping for breath. They were still not strong enough to handle a Tier 17 Formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 789: Clearing the Third Floor
paragraphs: [Three minutes before The Oddyssy of Death was activated - Val’s POV]
The moment Val assumed her goddess form, everything became crystal clear.
She no longer felt the pressure coming from the Hellhounds. Instead, she felt her body filled with so much energy that she couldn’t even think of how she would expend it.
Her body had become stronger, and her attack power had also increased.
Feeling the energy oozing from her body, she felt energized.
She then directed her attention to the hellhound. The aura coming from it was just too potent for any of her sisters and friends to face it.
She immediately felt a repulsion toward it. The energy coming from the hellhound is filled with evil intent.
"That is one evil intent. I wonder what kind of abomination they did to this creature." Instead of pointing her sword at the hellhound, she extended her hand, forming a potent moon energy.
She made it fly toward the hellhound, whose body was being pressed down by her overwhelming presence.
The hellhound may be a powerful Spirit Lord, but under the goddess’s power, it didn’t stand a chance. Slowly, the energy Val sent flying fell on it and engulfed it in a white radiance.
"Hmm, that is a demonic art aimed at devouring the life force of all living things. It’s even more advanced than the life-devouring array Alina showed us.
If not because this city was protected by a formation causing it to devour the life force of its inhabitants much slower, this bastard would have long reached the heavily ascension stage."
Val smirked, then extended her hand, conjuring a mighty sword.
"Time for you to die." With a gesture, the sword fell, piercing the neck of the large hellhound. It died rather quickly.
The moment the colossal body fell, she waved her hand, and the dark energy around it was cleansed.
"Veera would find a good use for you." Though it will be suppressed to the Core formation stage, the moment Kent ascends to a high world, Veera can start to increase her cultivation base.
This will also allow the hellhound to regain its cultivation.
With that, she moved away just in time for the Oddyssy of Death formation to be activated.
Meanwhile, Kent was also slowly moving toward the completion of his side of the battle.
He had established the foundation for his sword technique and was only waiting for the rest of the tigers to be dealt with before killing the Tiger King.
Of course, when the last of the tigers fell, he paused and looked at the battered and scared form of the Tiger King. The hellhound he was using to brag was killed in under three minutes.
If nothing else scared him, then that alone was something that scared the shit out of him. Kent smiled, knowing the battle was over. He accomplished what he wanted, and so the battle was a wrap.
"Thank you for your help. Had it not been for you, I wouldn’t have gained the clarity to form the foundation for my first sword technique.
To thank you properly, I will now use the technique I created to cut off your arm." Kent raised his sword and brought it toward him.
Then, trailing his finger along the blade, a powerful golden flame filled with intent and sword aura appeared on the sword, causing a powerful air to start rising around Kent.
"I will call this technique, ’Genesis Flame Sword.’"
Kent took a powerful swing, sending out a golden arc, one that turned the color of the surroundings golden for a moment, and then everything returned to normal.
However, long after the attack ended, King Renie screamed agonizingly as the pain from the attack was finally registered by his brain.
His right hand was cleanly severed from the shoulder, causing the sword in his hand to thud on the ground, still gripping it.
"That was for helping me create this sword technique foundation." Kent smiled, but genuine happiness was not evident in his smile.
Vexthra told him that the wounds Camilla had sustained had been healed, and now, all she needed was rest; in a few months, perhaps, she would be as good as new.

So he was happy on that front, but angry at the Tiger King for being the cause of this. Of course, that was Kent just being petty. He just needed an excuse to torture the bastard, and now, he had one.
"Though the sword technique is still not perfect, it would allow me to sever your legs." His fingers trailed the blade of his sword, engulfing it in the potent flame energy.
Kent attacked again, and this time, the king lost both his legs. However, it didn’t end there; Kent went ahead and severed the rest of his arm and even went so far as to cut off King Renie’s ears.
By the time he was done, the king was nothing but a limbless tiger on the ground.

’Hmm, I wonder why none of them used their beast form during the battle,’ Kent suddenly noticed something. Despite the tigers being beasts, they all fought in their humanoid form, not even one taking their beast form.
This made Kent wonder why they had done that.
"Were they too confident they would win, that instead of taking on their strongest form, they became cocky?"
For some reason, Kent didn’t believe that.

The tigers in the unbreakable city aren’t all weak. They may be cocky, but when their wall came down, they knew the new enemy wasn’t like the others, so at that moment, they could have used their beast forms.
But they didn’t. This means that something else was involved.
"I will find out soon enough. After all, this floor isn’t like the others. I feel like this floor is real and not animated. Meaning, strangely, my team and I have appeared in a high world."
Kent took out the world teleporter; however, no new world was registered on it.
"Perhaps I may be wrong." He formed a ball of fire and threw it at the dying body of the tiger king. In a few seconds, his body was reduced to ash, screaming through those short seconds.
⟦Congratulations on clearing the third floor of the Dungeon. Your rewards have been sent to the tower storage⟧
Kent sighed, looking at the ash remains of the tiger king.

"Perhaps next time, I should be wary of when I choose to form the next sword foundation. This time around, had it not been for Val helping with the hellhound, I would have been forced to abandon the process and focus on the battle instead.
But now that I have formed the perfect foundation, I can start building the various forms. The requirements said I needed seven forms.
The current patterns can handle only five forms.
So I would need to add new ones to accommodate two more forms?"
Kent moved and was soon hovering in the air, looking over the destruction he and his team had caused.
"Though they didn’t get to end the battle with Plan A, they did manage to kill almost 50,000 tigers. That is enough for them to be happy about.

Though I am sure they are happy looking at the defeated looks on the faces," Kent turned and looked at his legion, every last one of them looking dull like they hadn’t just gone into battle against a bunch of Spirit Kings and Emperors.
He smiled and moved toward them.
